maintainedBy: hand-edited. Candidates come from tools/34-terms.mjs; the Vietnamese side is a human decision, never generated.

statuses.fixed: settled Vietnamese Buddhist convention; use it everywhere without re-deciding
statuses.fixed-set: a CLOSED set of permitted renderings, chosen per passage for readability. viVariants lists every allowed form - anything outside it is drift, not style. Phase 5's consistency sweep must treat the listed variants as equivalent.
statuses.provisional: proposed, and used consistently, but not yet confirmed by the project owner
statuses.open: competing renderings exist and the choice has NOT been made - see glossary/decisions.md. Do not translate these silently; pick once, then record it.

rules: sinh, never sanh: chung sinh, sinh tu, tai sinh

terms.note: pháp = a dharma/phenomenon, and the general word. Pháp = the Buddha teaching as such, where it stands alone and capitalised. giáo pháp = the body of teaching being expounded, incl. the sa-bcad heading ཆོས་ཀྱི་ཆེ་བ. Nothing else. chánh pháp is NOT licensed - it adds a qualifier the Tibetan does not have.
từ bi only where the text pairs it with བྱམས་པ
tam-muội reserved for where the text transliterates rather than translates
quan điểm where it is plainly non-technical
định nghĩa where the sense is a definition, not a characteristic - decide per occurrence and flag
bát-nhã only inside ཤེས་རབ་ཀྱི་ཕར་ཕྱིན and text titles

Chosen per passage so the prose reads smoothly. Use the headword tịnh chỉ in section headings and wherever the term is being defined or argued about; chỉ inside the fixed compound chỉ quán; thiền chỉ where the sense is the practice itself. Keep one choice stable within a single section.
Pairs with ཞི་གནས - if that reads chỉ in a sentence, this reads quán; if tịnh chỉ, then thắng quán. Never mix registers within one sentence.

p0052, the fifth notion: དེ་བཞིན་གཤེགས་པ་ལ་སྐྱེས་བུ་དམ་པའི་འདུ་ཤེས. Kept distinct from སྐྱེ་བོ་མཆོག (bậc thượng nhân) and སྐྱེས་བུ་ཆེན་པོ (bậc thượng).

Section headword (ཆོས་དང་ཆོས་སྨྲ་བ་ལ་རིམ་གྲོ་བསྐྱེད་པ). Part of the རིམ་གྲོ / གུས་པ / བཀུར་སྟི / བཀུར་བ family, which was collapsing onto one or two Vietnamese words. Each now has its OWN primary word so the four stay distinguishable; the single exception is the established compound རྙེད་བཀུར = lợi dưỡng và cung kính. SUPERSEDES an earlier provisional "hủy báng Chánh pháp". སྤོང་/སྤངས་ is abandon/reject, NOT slander. The Sarvavaidalyasamgraha passage at p0043 turns on the contrast between སྤོང་བ (khước bỏ) and སྐུར་པ་འདེབས་པ (phỉ báng) - collapsing them into one word destroys the argument the sutra is making. Also: chánh pháp is not licensed by the ཆོས fixed-set.

thời tiền hoằng / thời hậu hoằng
terms.note: The two diffusions of the teaching in Tibet
Deliberate exception to ཤེས་རབ = trí tuệ. The three trainings form a fixed Sino-Vietnamese triad giới học / định học / tuệ học; forcing trí tuệ học breaks it. Applies ONLY inside this compound.
Full form of ཕར་ཕྱིན. Same Vietnamese - the Tibetan long/short alternation is not reproduced.
Variant spelling of the full form; same Vietnamese.
Person sense. The quality sense (maitri) stays từ - see the kind:term entry. Disambiguate by context; both are correct.

p0040, ཨ་ཏི་ཤའི་གདམས་ངག → "lời giáo huấn của ngài Atiśa". Wording kept. glossary.json still has no standalone entry for ཨ་ཏི་ཤ — the name appears only inside the notes on ཇོ་བོ / ཇོ་བོ་ཆེན་པོ. Needs its own entry, cross-linked to the existing fixed entry མར་མེ་མཛད → "Nhiên Đăng" (same person, different name) and to ཇོ་བོ / ཇོ་བོ་ཆེན་པོ, so a later chunk cannot silently unify or split them. firstSeen: c010 (or earlier if ཨ་ཏི་ཤ occurs before p0040).

p0038, inside the Tönpa Rinpoche quotation. No glossary ruling exists for this idiom. The literal rendering was kept per the no-expansion rule for quotations, but the phrase is idiomatic (taking the whole of the teaching onto the path as one four-square block) and is likely to recur; a ruling would fix whether it stays literal ("vuông vức") everywhere.

Named in the c011 findings as part of the same systematic registration gap. Occurs at source/clean/p0024.txt (རྗེ་བཙུན་བྱམས་པས་མཛད་པའི་མངོན་པར་རྟོགས་པའི་རྒྱན་གྱི་གདམས་ངག) and is rendered *Hiện Quán Trang Nghiêm* in translation/c005.md line 15, but glossary.json has no kind:"title" entry for it. Wording is correct and unchanged; only the central registration is missing. (The other two titles the finding cited — མཛོད and བསྒོམ་པའི་རིམ་པ — are now registered; བྱང་ཆུབ་ལམ་གྱི་སྒྲོན་མ is too.)

p0051, verse: དེ་དག་བཟོད་ལྡན་གྲོགས་དགའ་དབང་པོ་བསྡམས། The glossary has an entry for དགེ་བའི་བཤེས་གཉེན = thiện tri thức but none for bare གྲོགས. A ruling is needed so bare གྲོགས is never upgraded to the doctrinal term: 'bạn hữu' / 'bạn' only, with no value-word. This is the term the rejected 'bạn lành' came from.

Parsed as a verse-compressed predicate 'delights in companions', parallel to བཟོད་ལྡན and དབང་པོ་བསྡམས in the same line. Recording the parse because the alternative reading (dgaʼ ba as modifier of grogs) would give 'bạn thân thiết' and is not the order the Tibetan has.

p0052, twice: once in prose (ཆོས་ཀྱི་མེ་ལོང་དུ་འཆར་) and once in the Jātaka verse (ཆོས་ཀྱི་མེ་ལོང་གསལ་མཐོང་ན). Derived from the ཆོས fixed-set, but the compound itself has no entry and 'chánh pháp' was the natural pull. Worth pinning centrally: 'của' carries ཀྱི; do not collapse to 'gương pháp' or expand to 'gương Chánh pháp'.

Fourth of the five listening-attitudes quoted from བྱང་ས at p0048 line 1. No glossary entry exists. བཏུད་པ (from འདུད་པ, to bend/bow) takes no object in the Tibetan, so the object is bracketed as supplied. A ruling is needed for the whole five-member set (ཀུན་ཤེས་པར་འདོད་པ, རྩེ་གཅིག་པ, རྣ་བླགས་པ, ཡིད་བཏུད་པ, སེམས་ཐམས་ཅད་ཀྱིས་བསམས་པ), which recurs.

glossary.json now carries two entries for the same sūtra under two Tibetan forms, with two different Vietnamese spellings: ཏིང་ངེ་འཛིན་གྱི་རྒྱལ་པོ → "Kinh Tam Muội Vương" (provisional, firstSeen batch) and ཏིང་ངེ་འཛིན་རྒྱལ་པོ → "Kinh Tam-muội Vương" (fixed, decidedOn 2026-08-24). This chunk has the ག form but I followed the decided spelling. The two entries should be merged, or the ག form's vi corrected, so the Phase 5 sweep does not report the pair as drift.

The contracted dvandva of ཞི་གནས + ལྷག་མཐོང. glossary.json has entries for both members but none for the contraction, so nothing states which register the contraction takes. p0029 line 3 (`ཞི་ལྷག་ཟུང་དུ་འབྲེལ་བའི་ལྷག་མཐོང་གི་ཏིང་ངེ་འཛིན`) is rendered `song vận hợp nhất của chỉ và quán` in c007.md line 27-28, i.e. the licensed `chỉ quán` register with `và` supplied for Vietnamese. Kept as is — no ruling departed from — but the contraction should get its own entry so the Phase 5 sweep does not read the bare `chỉ` inside it as a violation of the ཞི་གནས entry.

The existing provisional entry reads 'hủy báng Chánh pháp' and directly contradicts the newer fixed-set ཆོས entry ('chánh pháp is NOT licensed') and the sibling entry ཆོས་སྤོང་བའི་ལས་ཀྱི་སྒྲིབ་པ = 'nghiệp chướng của việc bỏ pháp'. སྤོང་/སྤངས་ is 'abandon, reject', not 'slander'; the Sarvavaidalyasaṃgraha passage on p0043 turns on the contrast between སྤོང་བ and སྐུར་པ་འདེབས་པ (phỉ báng), so the two must not collapse into one word. Chunk now uses 'khước bỏ pháp' throughout. Needs the provisional entry replaced/superseded.

p0044 Samādhirāja verse. Same verb as ཆོས་སྤོང་; recorded so the pair stays parallel. མདོ་སྡེ kept as 'kinh điển' (glossary elsewhere has མདོ་སྡེ = 'các bộ kinh' only in passing, inside the རྒྱུད་སྡེ note) — no ruling exists for the bare word.

No entry for the written-out form; only the contracted དམ་ཆོས = 'Diệu pháp' (fixed) exists. p0043 has དམ་པའི་ཆོས་སྤོང་བའི་ལས་ཀྱི་སྒྲིབ་པ, where the verifier explicitly licensed 'Chánh pháp'. A ruling is needed on whether དམ་པའི་ཆོས follows དམ་ཆོས ('Diệu pháp') or is allowed 'Chánh pháp' — the two are currently in tension, and the same phrase recurs in the title དམ་པའི་ཆོས་པདྨ་དཀར་པོ.

p0045, Udānavarga verse. No ruling on རིགས་ here; rendered flatly as 'dòng dõi' because the verse supplies no qualifier (no 'cao quý', 'thượng lưu' etc.). Contrast ཡ་རབས་རྣམས (same page) = 'các bậc cao quý', which does carry the sense.
Āryadeva. Cited at p0065 by its short Tibetan name བཞི་བརྒྱ་པ for the 'gzu bor gnas' verse. Established Sino-Vietnamese short title (四百論). Not verified against an existing Vietnamese edition.

Bhāvaviveka. Cited at p0065. Literal Tibetan is 'tinh yếu của Trung đạo'; the established Sino-Vietnamese title (中觀心論) was used so the work can be located. Not verified against an existing Vietnamese edition.
Cited at p0065-p0066. སོ་སོར་ཐར་པ rendered 'Biệt Giải Thoát', consistent with the existing glossary entry སོ་སོར་ཐར་པའི་སྡོམ་པ = 'luật nghi biệt giải thoát'.

p0066, last words of the chunk. Tibetan name left in transcription, as with Naktso/Drolungpa. Almost certainly the same figure as the glossary's སྟོན་པ་རིན་པོ་ཆེ = 'Tönpa Rinpoche' (Dromtönpa); the two forms should be cross-linked rather than silently unified.

The first of the disciple's three qualities. Verse form at p0065 is spelt གཟུར་གནས; the prose gloss ཕྱོགས་ལྷུང་མེད་པ fixes the sense as impartiality/absence of bias. 'công chính' chosen over 'chánh trực' (which reads as moral uprightness) and over 'vô tư' (too colloquial). Used identically in verse, gloss and summary list so the term is visibly one term.

Rendered literally and kept identical across the Madhyamakahṛdaya verse (ཕྱོགས་སུ་ལྷུང་བས) and the prose gloss that quotes it back, since the gloss defines the verse's word. A compact 'thiên chấp' would have broken that link.
Same Vietnamese as the glossary's ལེགས་གསུངས = 'lời khéo giảng'; also used for ལེགས་པར་བཤད་པ in the same paragraph.
Deliberate antonym-pairing with ལེགས་བཤད = 'lời khéo giảng'; occurs twice at p0066 and the whole argument is the contrast between the two.

terms.vi: cái chỉ tương tự như đạo
terms.note: p0066, predicated of ཉེས་བཤད. ལྟར་སྣང = 'merely appearing to be'; rendered descriptively rather than with 'tương tự đạo' alone, which would not carry the 'only apparent' force.
Second of the three qualities; also the summary phrase བློ་དང་ལྡན་པ. Kept as bare 'có trí' — the text supplies no qualifier and ཤེས་རབ (trí tuệ) is not the word used.
Third of the three qualities. Glossed in the same passage by དོན་དུ་གཉེར་བ་ཆེན་པོ་དང་ལྡན་པ; rendered 'hết lòng cầu tìm pháp' for ཆོས་ལ་དོན་གཉེར་ཆེ་བ in the summary list.
p0066, the pair naming what supports and what obstructs the four qualities.

p0066, last sentence. Rendered non-technically: here it is the act of examining whether one has the qualities, not the vitarka/vicāra pair of the dhyāna literature, so 'tầm tứ' was deliberately avoided. See flag.
In the Bodhisattvaprātimokṣa quotation. Same rendering already used in translation/c005.md for མཁན་པོ; recording it centrally since glossary.json has no entry.
In the same quotation. Follows the glossary's སློབ་དཔོན་ཆེན་པོ = 'đại A-xà-lê'; recording the bare word, which has no entry.
p0066, སྙིང་པོ་མེད་པའི་ཕྱོགས་དོར་ནས་སྙིང་པོ་ལེན. Distinct from the 'heart/essence' of text titles such as དབུ་མའི་སྙིང་པོ.
p0066, ཆོས་ཀྱི་བཀའ་དྲིན་ནོད་པར་བྱ. Rendered literally ('receive the kindness of the Dharma') rather than flattened to 'thọ pháp', which would lose བཀའ་དྲིན.

No entry for the bare word; glossary has only compounds (ལྷ་བླ་མ, རྒྱུད་བླ་མ, སྒོམ་པ་རིན་ཆེན་བླ་མ). 'thượng sư' is used in c005, c006, c008-c011, c017-c020, c022 and no competing form (đạo sư, lạt-ma, bổn sư) occurs anywhere in translation/. Kept as-is; recommend recording as status 'fixed'.

No ruling, so kept per the gap rule (L17, L35, L49, L63 — the only occurrences anywhere in translation/). BUT flagging the wording itself for the ruling: the text's own gloss two sentences later is ཕྱོགས་ལྷུང་མེད་པ = 'không rơi về một bên', i.e. impartiality, whereas 'công chính' reads as moral rectitude. If the ruling goes to 'không thiên vị' / 'vô tư' (c007 L45 already uses 'không thiên vị', c035 L63 'vô tư'), c021 should be revised with it — including the quoted verse line L17 and the gloss at L35.

c021 L29 and L58; load-bearing, since it names the source of the four-vs-five enumeration of the listener's qualities. No ruling for the bare word (glossary has only the title ཤེས་རབ་སྒྲོན་མེའི་རྒྱ་ཆེར་འགྲེལ་པ). Kept as-is.

c021 L50 has 'chân chánh' beside 'công chính' (L17, L35, L49, L63) and 'chính là' (L63). houseStyle is declared northern but its rules list only sinh/sanh and phúc/phước, so there is no ruling on chính/chánh. Corpus already mixes both: 'chân chính' in c011, c018; 'chân chánh' in c014, c021, c025, c027, c031. Kept as-is pending a ruling. The two rules that do exist are clean in c021 — no 'sanh', no 'phước'.

terms.vi: Lợi ích của việc nương tựa
terms.note: sa-bcad heading 6.1.1.4, present in the source at p0078 line 3. ཕན་ཡོན = lợi ích, matching c012's 'lợi ích của việc nghe pháp' (ཐོས་པའི་ཕན་ཡོན); བསྟེན་པ = nương tựa, matching c011's 'cách thức nương tựa thiện tri thức'.

Cited at p0078 without མདོ, so no 'Kinh' prefix. Left in Sanskrit following the precedent of རྣམ་པར་འཐག་པ་ཐམས་ཅད་བསྡུས་པའི་མདོ → 'Kinh Sarvavaidalyasaṃgraha': no settled standalone Vietnamese title exists. The literal Tibetan is 'Thọ Trang Nghiêm' (སྡོང་པོ = cây/thân cây, བཀོད་པ = trang nghiêm). Deliberately NOT rendered 'Kinh Hoa Nghiêm' — Avataṃsaka is a different Tibetan title (ཕལ་པོ་ཆེ), and collapsing them would misrepresent what the source cites. See flag.

Cited at p0079 in this short form only, without མདོ, so no 'Kinh' prefix. Rendered literally from the Tibetan components: གསང་བ = bí mật, བསམ་གྱིས་མི་ཁྱབ་པ = bất tư nghì. The full sūtra title (with དེ་བཞིན་གཤེགས་པའི་ / བསྟན་པ) is not what the text writes here.

terms.vi: thiện nam tử / thiện nữ nhân
terms.note: Vocative in both sūtra quotations. The established Sino-Vietnamese equivalents (善男子/善女人) are used as lexical equivalents of the term of art; note that the Tibetan literally says only 'con của dòng dõi' and carries no word for 'thiện'. Kept distinct from the glossary's རིགས་སྐྱེས་པའི་མི = 'người sinh trong dòng dõi', which was deliberately left flat. See flag.

p0078 (བསམ་སྦྱོར་དགེ་བ) and unpacked across p0079 (བསམ་པ་དགེ་བ … སྦྱོར་བ་དགེ་བ). བསམ་པ = ý lạc (意樂), སྦྱོར་བ = gia hành (加行). Bears directly on sections 6.1.1.3.1 བསམ་པས་བསྟེན་པའི་ཚུལ and 6.1.1.3.2 སྦྱོར་བས་བསྟེན་པའི་ཚུལ (c022–c024), which are not yet translated; whichever rendering those fix should govern, and this chunk aligned to it.

p0079. Same Vietnamese as the glossary's ཀུན་མཁྱེན = 'bậc Nhất Thiết Trí', but without 'bậc' because here it is the state one draws near to (ཉེ་བར་འགྱུར), not a person. Kept distinct from རྣམ་པ་ཐམས་ཅད་མཁྱེན་པ = Nhất Thiết Chủng Trí.
p0078, སངས་རྒྱས་ཀྱི་གོ་འཕང = 'địa vị Phật'. Consistent with the glossary's བདུད་རྩིའི་གོ་འཕང = 'địa vị cam lộ'.
Occurs three times across p0078–p0079 (ངན་འགྲོར་མི་ལྟུང་བ, ངན་འགྲོ་མྱོང་བའི་ལས). No glossary entry yet.

Five occurrences across p0078–p0079. Rendered 'phụng sự'; 'cung kính phụng sự' only where the Tibetan itself adds གུས་པས (p0079). Paired at p0079 with བརྟེན་པ = nương tựa and བསྙེན་པ = thân cận, all three kept distinct.
p0079, of a root of virtue outshining others. Rendered non-figuratively; the Tibetan idiom is 'overwhelm with splendour'.

p0079, ལས་དེ་འདྲོངས་ནས་ཟད་པར་འགྱུར་བ. Sense established from the corpus's other ten occurrences (p0030 སྤྱན་འདྲོངས་ཏེ = 'thỉnh mời'; p0185 ངེས་ཤེས་ཅི་འདྲོངས་ལ་འབད; p0698 ངེས་པ་... འདྲོངས་ནས), all 'draw out / elicit / bring forth' — i.e. a variant of the དྲངས་ / འདྲེན་པ family. Deliberately NOT rendered 'trổ quả sớm' or 'chín muồi', which is the doctrinal gloss but not what the word says. See flag.
p0078 and p0079 (ཡོན་ཏན་གྱི་ཚོགས་ཐམས་ཅད་རྫོགས་པར་བྱའོ). Bare ཚོགས at p0078 (ཚོགས་རྫོགས་པར་འགྱུར་བ) rendered 'các tư lương'.
p0079, བདག་དང་གཞན་རྗེས་སུ་བསྲུང་བ. Kept distinct from བསྐྱངས་པ (p0078, of the teacher protecting the bodhisattva), also rendered 'hộ trì' — see flag on the near-synonym cluster.

Cited at p0058 line 13 for the two-pada verse 'rigs la gnas pa'i gang zag des // bshes gnyen dam pa bsten byas la //'. Rendered from the Tibetan components (སྙིང་པོ = tinh yếu, ངེས་པར་ = quyết định, བསྡུ་བ = tập/nhiếp). The underlying Sanskrit work is NOT identified — see flags. Note ངེས་པར་བསྡུ་བ is deliberately not given the glossary's 'quyết trạch', which is reserved for གཏན་ལ་དབབ་པ.
Cited at p0059 for the long prose passage on everything depending on the guru. སྡེ་སྣོད = tạng per the existing glossary entry.

The bare form, used throughout this section as the abbreviation of དགེ་བའི་བཤེས་གཉེན (already fixed = thiện tri thức). The source itself confirms the identity: the six-fold outline at p0059 writes the full དགེ་བའི་བཤེས་གཉེན for the same referent that the section heading calls བཤེས་གཉེན. Same Vietnamese for both.

terms.vi: bậc thiện tri thức chân chính
terms.note: Occurs three times (two verse citations plus the prose at p0059). དམ་པ rendered 'chân chính'; kept distinct from སྐྱེས་བུ་དམ་པ = 'bậc chân nhân' already in the glossary.
Kadampa master, quoted twice on p0059 (once via Dölpa's compilation of his sayings, once with ཞལ་ནས). Tibetan name left in transcription, as with ngài Kamapa.
p0059, པོ་ཏོ་བའི་གསུང་སྒྲོས་དོལ་པས་བསྒྲིགས་པ — the compiler of Potowa's sayings. Transcription only.
p0059, 'tập ngữ lục của ngài Potowa'. The source names no title for the collection, so none is supplied.

p0058, གདམས་པ་སྟོན་པའི་སྔོན་འགྲོའི་མཆོག and the closing གདམས་པའི་སྔོན་འགྲོ་བཤད་ཟིན་ཏོ. This names the whole preceding division (chunks c012–c017), which are not yet translated — whichever rendering they fix should govern, and this chunk aligned to it.
p0058–p0059 verse, རིགས་ལ་གནས་པའི་གང་ཟག. See flags — the bare word could also be read 'dòng dõi' (family/caste), as the glossary's རིགས་སྐྱེས་པའི་མི entry does.
In the Bodhisattvapiṭaka list at p0059.
Translated rather than transliterated (đà-la-ni), following the project rule that transliteration is reserved for where the Tibetan itself transliterates — the Tibetan here translates.
In the Bodhisattvapiṭaka list at p0059.
The bodhisattva grounds, in the Bodhisattvapiṭaka list. Rendered 'các địa'.
p0059, in Potowa's saying: ངན་སོང་ནས་འོངས་མ་ཐག་པ.
Same Vietnamese as the fixed ཐར་པ = giải thoát; recorded so the Phase 5 sweep does not read the two Tibetan words as one, nor the shared Vietnamese as drift.
Fourth item of the six-fold outline at p0059.
Fifth item of the six-fold outline at p0059; the standing counterpart of ཕན་ཡོན.
p0058, བསྟེན་ནས་བློ་ཇི་ལྟར་སྦྱང་བའི་རིམ་པ — names the entire second half of the book, so it needs a central ruling before the chunks that use it.
p0058, the second sub-topic of 6.1. See flags — the object of སྐྱོང་བ is not stated in the Tibetan.
Appears in the section heading 6.1.1 (ངེས་པ་བསྐྱེད་པའི་ཕྱིར) and in the p0058 prose. Already used this way in c011; not yet in glossary.json.

l.24, l.26, l.27 — standalone `རིམ་པ` in the sa-bcad headings. No ruling for the bare term; the only recorded note (under `རིམ་པ་གཉིས`) says '`རིམ་པ` rendered thứ đệ, consistent with ལམ་རིམ = Đạo Thứ Đệ'. Wording KEPT: c004/c005 already render this exact heading with 'trình tự', so c018 follows precedent rather than drifting. A ruling is needed to separate the two renderings — plausibly 'thứ đệ' inside fixed compounds and titles, 'trình tự' for the ordinary sa-bcad 'the stages of / the order in which'.

l.24, l.26, l.47, l.69. No ruling. Wording KEPT: matches c004; c002 uses 'đệ tử' in a different context. This is a heading-level term for the whole བཤེས་གཉེན་བསྟེན་ཚུལ division (it names sub-section 2, `སྟེན་བྱེད་སློབ་མའི་མཚན་ཉིད`), so it will recur constantly and needs pinning against 'đệ tử'.
p0063, inside Potowa's saying: ངེད་ཀྱི་སློབ་དཔོན་ཞང་བཙུན. Tibetan name left in transcription, as with Naktso, Drolungpa, Gönpawa. See flag on the following ཀུན.
p0063, the second master named in Potowa's saying. Transcription.
Cited at p0064. དཔུང་བཟང = Subāhu = 妙臂 Diệu Tý (established Sino-Vietnamese); ཞུས་པ = thỉnh vấn. Vietnamese form not verified against an existing edition.
p0063, the sandalwood simile in prose and in the Samādhirāja verse. The verse also spells it ཙནྡན once (Sanskrit-style stack); rendered identically.
p0063 Samādhirāja verse. Kept as 'hương liệu' (the aromatic substance) rather than 'hương thơm' (the smell), because the verse's point is that the man does not possess the goods.
p0064: རྣམ་གྲོལ་བསྒྲུབ་པའི་བླ་མ་ནི་གཏན་གྱི་འདུན་མའི་རྩ་བ. Kadam idiom for the lasting/final aim. Rendered descriptively; no compact Sino-Vietnamese form chosen.
p0064 Subāhuparipṛcchā verse. Rendered literally, kept distinct from སེམས་ཅན = chúng sinh (fixed).
p0064. Same rendering already used in c005.
p0064 verse: བྲམ་ཟེ་དང་ནི་ལྷ་གཞན་མཆོད་མི་བྱེད.
p0064 verse.
p0064 verse. Rendered literally from the Tibetan (རྩོད་པ = tranh/đấu tranh) rather than with 'thời mạt pháp', which the Tibetan does not say.
p0064 verse: སྔགས་པའི་གྲོགས་པོར་བསྟེན. Aligned with the glossary's གསང་སྔགས་ཐེག་པ = Mật Chú thừa.

terms.vi: buổi giảng đáp lễ cúng dường
terms.note: p0063, in Potowa's saying about Nyentön. A discourse given in return for offerings (ཡོན). Rendered descriptively; see flag.

p0063, the fifth of Potowa's five chief qualities. c019 covers བརྩེ་བ where it is defined (p0062, ཆོས་སྟོན་པའི་ཀུན་སློང་དག་པ); whichever rendering c019 fixes should govern, and this chunk aligned to it.

Chapter of the Udānavarga (ཆེད་དུ་བརྗོད་པའི་ཚོམས), cited at p0082-83. Rendered on the same pattern already fixed for ཐོས་པའི་ཚོམས = Phẩm Văn: only the chapter is named, because only the chapter is named in the Tibetan. མཛའ་བཤེས = thân hữu, ཚོམས = phẩm (varga). The word མཛའ་ falls at the end of p0082 and བཤེས་ཀྱི་ཚོམས at the start of p0083.
The negative counterpart of དགེ་བའི་བཤེས་གཉེན = thiện tri thức (fixed). p0083, where the text gives its definition. Kept as the exact mirror so the pair stays visible in Vietnamese.

terms.vi: điều đáng chê trách thuộc bản tánh và do chế định
terms.note: p0083. The standard pair natural / proscribed misdeed. Rendered descriptively ('cả loại thuộc bản tánh lẫn loại do chế định') rather than with the compact Sino-Vietnamese tánh tội / giá tội, which would import two technical terms the Tibetan does not spell out here. Builds on the existing entries ཁ་ན་མ་ཐོ་བ་མེད་པ and བཅས་པའི་མཚམས.
p0083. བླ་མ = thượng sư, as in c005 ('thượng sư Rāhulagupta'); རྣལ་འབྱོར = du-già, as in the existing རྣལ་འབྱོར་དབང་ཕྱུག = Du-già Tự Tại. Not left as the loanword 'guru yoga'.

p0083, quoted with ཞལ་ནས. Kadampa master (Chekawa Yeshe Dorje), normally spelt འཆད་ཀ་བ / མཆད་ཁ་བ; the source spells མཆད་ཀ་བ. Transcription follows the practice for other Tibetan masters (Naktso, Gönpawa). See flag.
p0083, དམིགས་པ་ཐུན་རེ་ཙམ་ལ་སྦྱངས་པ — the object taken up in meditation. No entry existed; 'sở duyên' chosen over 'quán tưởng', which would name a practice rather than the object.
p0083, ཐུན་རེ་ཙམ = 'chừng một đôi thời khóa'. Recorded because the whole of section 6.1.2 (from c028 on) turns on ཐུན and ཐུན་མཚམས; the two should be fixed together.
p0084, དྲི་མ་མེད་པའི་གསུང་རབ་དང་དགོངས་འགྲེལ. Built on the existing དགོངས་པ = mật ý. Distinct from འགྲེལ་པ alone.
p0084, སྣོད་རུང་གི་ཆོས་རྣམས. Built on the existing སྣོད = bình chứa, so the three-faults-of-the-vessel simile and this phrase stay visibly connected.
p0084, of a teacher taking a student under his care. The Tibetan leaves the agent unstated; the Vietnamese supplies it in brackets ('được [bậc thầy] như thế nhiếp thọ').
p0084. ཚོགས rendered 'tư lương' (the accumulations of merit and wisdom), the established Sino-Vietnamese.
p0084, རྒྱལ་སྲས་རྟག་ཏུ་ངུ = 'Phật tử Thường Đề', using the fixed རྒྱལ་སྲས = Phật tử. Established Sino-Vietnamese name (常啼).
p0084. གཞོན་ནུ = đồng tử; the established Vietnamese name Thiện Tài (善財) used rather than a literal rendering of ནོར་བཟང.
p0084, in the heading དེ་ལ་ལོག་རྟོག་དགག་པ = 'bác bỏ tà chấp đối với cách thức ấy' (section 6.1.2.2, whose full outline title is སྐྱོང་ཚུལ་དེ་ལ་ལོག་རྟོག་དགག་པ).

Cited at p0083 (chapter of the Udānavarga, same series as ཐོས་པའི་ཚོམས = "Phẩm Văn"). Follows that pattern: ཚོམས = phẩm (varga), བཤེས = thân hữu. Per decisions.md, cited titles are fixed at first occurrence — this is it.
No entry. Here ཚོགས་བསག = "tích tập tư lương" (accumulate the collections). Distinguish from ཚོགས in the sense of 'assembly/gathering' if that occurs elsewhere.

terms.vi: cách thức nương tựa bằng sự thực hành
terms.note: Section heading 6.1.1.3.2. སྦྱོར་བ (prayoga) here is the action/practice half of the pair with བསམ་པས་བསྟེན་པ (relying by thought), the preceding section. Rendered 'sự thực hành' rather than the Sino-Vietnamese 'gia hành' so it does not collide with 'Gia Hành đạo' (སྦྱོར་ལམ) already used in c005.

terms.vi: Ngũ Thập Tụng về Thượng Sư
terms.note: Aśvaghoṣa. Cited three times here; the source abbreviates it ལྔ་བཅུ་པ twice, rendered *Ngũ Thập Tụng*. Rendered from the Tibetan components rather than via the Chinese 事師法五十頌 (Sự Sư Pháp Ngũ Thập Tụng), which adds 'sự sư pháp' that the Tibetan does not have.
Maitreya/Asaṅga. Cited twice. The Tibetan names only མདོ་སྡེའི་རྒྱན (Sūtrālaṃkāra), so 'Đại Thừa' is not added.
Guṇaprabha's Vinayasūtra, cited at p0077 for 'ཆོས་མ་ཡིན་པ་སྨྲ་ན་བཟློག་པར་བྱའོ'.
Established Sino-Vietnamese title (寶雲經). p0077.
The Gaṇḍavyūha pilgrim. The Tibetan translates the Sanskrit; the established Vietnamese 'Thiện Tài' translates the same name, so it is used rather than a transcription of the Tibetan. p0075.
In the Gurupañcāśikā verse at p0075.
Material goods offered to the teacher; occurs four times across p0075–p0077, and is contrasted with ཆོས་ཀྱི་བགོ་སྐལ.
Sūtrālaṃkāra verse at p0077, and the prose gloss right after it. Kept literal — the point of the verse is the contrast between taking a share of Dharma and taking ཟང་ཟིང.
The Buddha as Teacher, in the Ānanda anecdote at p0077. Kept distinct from the personal name སྟོན་པ་རིན་པོ་ཆེ = Tönpa Rinpoche already in the glossary.
Kadampa master quoted at p0076 with ཞལ་ནས.
Quoted at p0076 with ཞལ་ནས. Transcribed as spelt; see flag — I could not identify the master.
Ānanda 'appointed as the Teacher's ཞམ་རིང', p0077.
p0075 verse. Same Vietnamese as the glossary's རྒྱལ་སྲས = Phật tử; recorded because two different Tibetan compounds now share it.

Glossary fixes only the full དགེ་བའི་བཤེས་གཉེན = 'thiện tri thức'. This chunk renders bare བཤེས (p0075 verse `འདི་དག་བདག་བཤེས་སངས་རྒྱས་བསྔགས་པ་ཞེས།`, l.20), བཤེས་གཉེན (p0075 and p0077 MSA verses, l.50, l.118) and དགེ་བཤེས (p0075 verse, l.25) all as 'thiện tri thức'. Text kept — no ruling exists. But this is the most consequential gap in the chunk: the existing གྲོགས entry was created precisely to forbid upgrading a plain 'friend' to the doctrinal term, and bare བཤེས sits one step from གྲོགས. A ruling is needed on whether all four forms collapse, or whether bare བཤེས must stay unelevated. Note c023 already renders the fuller form in the same Gaṇḍavyūha citation as 'thiện tri thức'.

terms.vi: Ngũ Thập Tụng về Thượng Sư (short: Ngũ Thập Tụng)
terms.note: l.32, 57, 75, 108. decisions.md requires cited titles to be registered at first occurrence; this one is absent. The short form ལྔ་བཅུ་པ needs registering as the same work.
p0075 MSA verse `བཀུར་སྟི་རྙེད་པ་དག་དང་རིམ་གྲོ་དང༌` (l.49). No entry; deliberately kept apart from ཟང་ཟིང = 'tài vật'.

p0060, cited as a scripture (སོ་སོར་ཐར་པ་ལས) and named again inside its own verse (སོ་སོར་ཐར་འདི་ཡིན). Same Vietnamese in both places. Distinct from the existing glossary entry སོ་སོར་ཐར་པའི་སྡོམ་པ = luật nghi biệt giải thoát, which is the vow, not the text.
p0060. Rendered literally from the Tibetan components. The text cites a single line.

p0060 verse (དེ་ཉིད་རབ་ཏུ་རྟོགས་པ) and p0061 prose, where the commentary glosses དེ་ཉིད with དེ་ཁོ་ན་ཉིད — so both forms are the same term and take one Vietnamese word. See flag: chân như is conventionally tathatā (དེ་བཞིན་ཉིད); chân thật tánh / thắng nghĩa would be the alternatives.
p0061, ཤེས་རབ་ཀྱི་བསླབ་པ་ཁྱད་པར་ཅན་ཆོས་བདག་མེད་པ་རྟོགས་པ.
p0062 verse, ཆོས་ཉིད་བདེན་པ = chân lý pháp tánh. Kept distinct from ཆོས = pháp (fixed-set) so the compound is not flattened.
p0062. Rendered descriptively rather than with the Sino-Vietnamese sở hóa, since the whole passage turns on the verb འདུལ་བ = điều phục and the link should stay visible.

p0060 verse ལུང་གིས་ཕྱུག = giàu về giáo điển. Deliberately NOT thánh giáo, which the glossary assigns to གསུང་རབ (used earlier on the same page), and not giáo pháp, which is ལུང་གི་བསྟན་པ. In the compound ལུང་གི་ཡོན་ཏན (p0061) the c005 wording công đức thuộc phần giáo was kept, and in ལུང་རིགས (p0061) it is giáo và lý.
First of the ten qualities; the same root carries the whole horse-taming simile on p0060–61 (འདུལ་བ, བཏུལ་བ, དམུ་རྒོད་འདུལ་སྦྱོང་མཁན, གདུལ་བྱ), all rendered with điều phục.
Second of the ten qualities, glossed as ཏིང་ངེ་འཛིན་གྱི་བསླབ་པ.
Third of the ten qualities, glossed as ཤེས་རབ་ཀྱི་བསླབ་པ. Recurs in the Mitra-varga verse on p0061–62.
Tenth quality, glossed on p0062 as ཡང་ཡང་འཆད་པས་མི་ངལ་བ — not weariness with saṃsāra but with repeated teaching, so 'chán nản' alone would mislead.
Eighth quality, glossed on p0062 as skill in the stages of guidance and in delivering the meaning into the disciple's mind.

Ninth quality (བརྩེ་བའི་བདག་ཉིད = bản tánh từ ái). Kept distinct from བྱམས་པ = từ and སྙིང་རྗེ = bi, both of which occur in its own gloss on p0062 (བྱམས་པ་དང་སྙིང་རྗེས་ཀུན་ནས་བསླངས), rendered 'lòng từ và lòng bi'.
p0062, ཆོས་སྟོན་པའི་ཀུན་སློང་དག་པ. Same rendering already used in c013; registering it centrally.
p0062, twice (འགྲོ་བའི་སྡུག་བསྔལ; འགྲོ་བ་ཉམ་ཐག་པ་མིན་པ་མེད). See flag — this collides with the fixed སེམས་ཅན = chúng sinh.
p0060–61, the untamed horse of the Prātimokṣa simile.
p0060, the bridle of the same simile; the source specifies གཟེར་རྣོན་བརྒྱ་པ = 'có trăm mũi nhọn'.
p0062. Kadampa master, quoted with གསུང་བ. Tibetan name left in transcription, as with Potowa and Dölpa in c018.
p0062, the addressee of Potowa's remark (པོ་ཏོ་བའི་ཞལ་ནས་སྤྱན་སྔ་ལ).
p0062, quoted with ཞལ་ནས, so read as a personal name. See flag — the reading is not secure.
p0062, རྭ་སྒྲེང་བའི་རྒད་པོ་དེ་རྣམས = 'các vị lão túc ở Radreng'. Left in Tibetan transcription.
p0062, Potowa's vocative to Chengawa. Rendered literally; see flag.

terms.vi: công đức chứng ngộ  |  công đức thuộc phần chứng
terms.note: Rendered two ways inside this one chunk: "công đức chứng ngộ" at l.31-32 (p0060, རྟོགས་པའི་ཡོན་ཏན་དུ་མིང་བཏགས་པ, where the term stands alone) and "công đức thuộc phần chứng" at l.60 (p0061 l.3, where it is in explicit contrast with ལུང་གི་ཡོན་ཏན = "công đức thuộc phần giáo" in the next clause). glossary.json registers only the sibling pair ལུང་གི་བསྟན་པ / རྟོགས་པའི་བསྟན་པ = "giáo pháp thuộc phần giáo / phần chứng". Both wordings kept because no ruling exists; recommend fixing རྟོགས་པའི་ཡོན་ཏན = "công đức thuộc phần chứng" (with ལུང་གི་ཡོན་ཏན = "công đức thuộc phần giáo") so the ཡོན་ཏན pair matches the already-registered བསྟན་པ pair, then normalising l.31-32.

དེ་ཉིད་རབ་ཏུ་རྟོགས་པ in the Sūtrālaṃkāra verse (p0060 l.3 -> l.21) and དེ་ཁོ་ན་ཉིད་མངོན་དུ་གྱུར་པ (p0061 l.4 -> l.69-70); also དེ་ཉིད་རྟོགས་པ at p0061 l.4 (l.69) and p0062 l.5 (l.119). No entry for either. "Chân như" is the standard Vietnamese for དེ་བཞིན་ཉིད / tathatā, so a later chunk containing དེ་བཞིན་ཉིད would collapse three Tibetan terms into one. Used the same way in c005 and c024, so the gap is central registration, not the wording. Consider fixing tattva = "chân thật nghĩa" / "chân thật tánh" and reserving "chân như" for tathatā.

p0061 l.4, p0062 l.5, p0062 l.1 -> l.64, l.109-110, l.89. None registered; glossary.json has only སྟོན་པ་རིན་པོ་ཆེ = "Tönpa Rinpoche". Cross-chunk spelling drift already exists and is not introduced here: "Geshé Tönpa" is spelt "Geshe Tönpa" (no acute) in c022 and c027, and "Chengawa" is spelt "Chen-ngawa" in c022. མཐའ་བཞི -> "Tazhi" occurs nowhere else, so nothing constrains it. Needs one ruling each, plus a decision on whether དགེ་བཤེས is transcribed ("Geshé") or translated. Wording kept here.
p0057, གནས་སྐབས་དང་མཐར་ཐུག་གི་སྨོན་གནས་རྣམས = 'những chỗ sở nguyện nhất thời và rốt ráo'. The objects toward which merit is dedicated.
p0057, འདུན་པ་དྲག་པོས = 'bằng lòng mong mỏi mãnh liệt'. Kept non-technical; not rendered 'dục' or 'thắng giải'.
p0056 verse, བདག་གི་བདེ་བའི་ཡོ་བྱད = 'tư cụ an lạc của ta'. The same phrase occurs in the prose on p0055, which falls in c016 — the two must be made to agree.

terms.vi: đi đúng vào chỗ trọng yếu
terms.note: p0057, twice (ཆོས་ཉན་བཤད་གནད་དུ་སོང་བ, འཆད་པ་དང་ཉན་པའི་ཚུལ་གནད་དུ་སོང་བ). 'Hits the vital point'. Rendered identically both times.

terms.vi: các bậc chân nhân đời trước
terms.note: p0057. Aligned to the glossary's སྐྱེས་བུ་དམ་པ = bậc chân nhân; 'đời trước' carries སྔ་མ. Not upgraded to 'thánh nhân'.
p0056, inside the Kinh Tam-muội Vương verse, addressed to the person making the request. Kept distinct from སྐྱེས་བུ་ཆེན་པོ = bậc thượng and སྐྱེ་བོ་མཆོག = bậc thượng nhân.

terms.vi: Sự khác biệt về đối tượng nào thì giảng và không giảng
terms.note: Outline s023, path 5.2.4, level 2 → '###'. ཡུལ here is the person taught, rendered 'đối tượng'.

terms.vi: Cách thức thực hành chung vào lúc kết thúc
terms.note: Outline s024, path 5.3, level 1 → '##'. ཐུན་མོང་དུ rendered 'chung' without naming between whom (teacher and listener), since the Tibetan does not name them here.
p0057 Vinaya list; rendered plainly rather than 'ủng/hia'.
p0057 Vinaya list, palanquin/litter, paired with བཞོན་པ = 'xe'.

No entry for བླ་མ at all in glossary.json. Occurs at c017 line 76 (གདམས་ངག་འདིའི་བླ་མ་གོང་མ་རྣམས). No competing rendering found elsewhere in the corpus; recorded only so a ruling exists for བླ་མ (and for the གོང་མ 'earlier/predecessor' modifier) before it recurs. Text left as is.
Section heading 5.2, the mirror of ཆོས་ཉན་པའི་ཚུལ = 'Cách thức nghe pháp' (c012). Kept parallel on purpose.
Bare བསམ་པ, the paired term with སྦྱོར་བ in heading 5.2.3 and used again for the listener's disposition on p0053 line 1. Consistent with the glossary's ལྷག་པའི་བསམ་པ = tăng thượng ý lạc.
The second member of the བསམ་པ་དང་སྦྱོར་བ pair: what the teacher actually does (bathing, seat, mantra, delivery). Established Sino-Vietnamese 加行.
Cited twice on p0054–p0055 (the five notions of the teacher; the Māra-subduing mantra). བློ་གྲོས་རྒྱ་མཚོ = Sāgaramati = Hải Tuệ; ཞུས་པ = thỉnh vấn. No existing Vietnamese title verified.

Śāntideva's compendium, cited by its short Tibetan name at p0054 in a note on old vs new Tibetan translations. Short established Sino-Vietnamese title (集學論); the full Chinese-derived form is Đại Thừa Tập Bồ Tát Học Luận.
p0054: ཆོས་ནི་སངས་རྒྱས་རྣམས་ཀྱིའང་བཀུར་བའི་ཞིང་ཡིན་པས. ཞིང = field kept as 'ruộng' rather than flattened to 'đối tượng', since the field metaphor is in the Tibetan. See flag.
ཆོས་ལ་དཔེ་མཁྱུད་བྱེད་པ, p0055. Literally 'holding the text in one's fist'; rendered by sense, since the Vietnamese has no matching idiom. Northern 'bỏn sẻn' per house style.

terms.vi: chi phần khiến xác quyết được ý nghĩa
terms.note: p0055, the three enumerated immediately after: དཔེ / གཏན་ཚིགས / ལུང.
In the triad thí dụ / chánh lý / giáo chứng. See flag — 'nhân' would be the logic-textbook rendering but reads wrongly beside ལས = nghiệp/nhân elsewhere.
p0055, from the Sāgaramatiparipṛcchā.
ལྷ་རྣམས་དེ་ལ་གཟི་བྱིན་བསྐྱེད་པ, 13th of the twenty benefits.
The audience being taught; occurs in prose (p0055) and twice in the Lotus verse.

Benefits 2–4 of the twenty, sitting immediately before ཤེས་རབ = trí tuệ (benefit 5). Four distinct Tibetan words needed four distinct Vietnamese words; the split is formal, not doctrinally argued. See flag.
Lotus verse, p0055: two Tibetan number-words compounded as an idiom for a vast quantity of examples. Rendered as a compound quantity rather than with exact numerals. See flag.

Part of the རིམ་གྲོ / གུས་པ / བཀུར་སྟི / བཀུར་བ family, which was collapsing onto one or two Vietnamese words. Each now has its OWN primary word so the four stay distinguishable; the single exception is the established compound རྙེད་བཀུར = lợi dưỡng và cung kính. Part of the རིམ་གྲོ / གུས་པ / བཀུར་སྟི / བཀུར་བ family, which was collapsing onto one or two Vietnamese words. Each now has its OWN primary word so the four stay distinguishable; the single exception is the established compound རྙེད་བཀུར = lợi dưỡng và cung kính. p0053 l.9, འདོད་ཆགས་ཆུང་བར་འགྱུར་བ; c016 line 34. No ruling. Wording kept (it matches c014, so this is not drift). COLLISION AHEAD: 'ái' is the standard Vietnamese for སྲེད་པ / tṛṣṇā, so once སྲེད་པ appears the two will be indistinguishable. A ruling should decide now between 'tham ái' and bare 'tham' for འདོད་ཆགས, reserving 'ái' for སྲེད་པ.

p0093, p0096. སྡོམ་པ here is sense-restraint, NOT the vow sense; glossary's སྡོམ་པ = 'luật nghi' must not be applied here. Kept distinct from བསྲུང་བ = 'phòng hộ' so the passage's analysis (gang gis sdom pa / gang sdom pa / gang las sdom pa / ji ltar bsdam pa / sdom pa gang yin pa) stays legible.
p0093, defined in the text. Paired against མངོན་རྟགས་སུ་འཛིན་པ; the two definitions differ, so the two Vietnamese renderings must stay apart.
p0093. Sanskrit given on the standard nimitta/anuvyañjana pairing for indriyasaṃvara; the Tibetan is literally 'apprehending as a manifest mark'. See flag.
p0093. Kept as the standard Sino-Vietnamese; contrasts with དྲན་པ = chánh niệm.
p0093, in the triad with དགེ་བ = thiện.
p0093. Established Abhidharma compound.
p0093-p0095, the second of the four ཚོགས་བཞི. ཤེས་བཞིན = tỉnh giác, per the glossary entry དྲན་པ་དང་ཤེས་བཞིན.
p0095, three times in the four-aspect passage.

terms.vi: sự đi lại / sự sinh hoạt
terms.note: p0093-p0094. The two sets of five actions: those of going about outside, and those performed in the vihāra (གཙུག་ལག་ཁང་ན་སྤྱོད་པའི་ལས་ལྔ). Note that སྤྱོད་པ is deliberately rendered two ways in this chunk — 'sinh hoạt' in these compounds, 'hành xử' in ཤེས་བཞིན་དུ་སྤྱོད་པ. See flag.

terms.vi: các chi lớn và chi nhỏ
thân giáo sư, A-xà-lê, thượng sư
terms.note: p0094. མཁན་པོ = thân giáo sư follows c005; སློབ་དཔོན = A-xà-lê follows c005's 'đại A-xà-lê'.
p0094. Built on the existing provisional གསུང་རབ = thánh giáo rather than the Chinese-derived 'thập nhị bộ kinh'.
p0094, ལུང་མ་མནོས་པའི་...ལུང་ནོད་ཅིང.

p0094, སེམས་དགུས་ཏིང་ངེ་འཛིན་དུ་བྱེད་པ. Read as short for སེམས་གནས་དགུ, the nine mental abidings, on the evidence of p0596 (ཡིད་བྱེད་བཞི་དང་སེམས་དགུས་བསྒྲུབ་དགོས་པ) in the śamatha section. 'trụ' is bracketed as supplied. See flag — p0067 uses the same string for a different nine.
p0096. Negative of the glossary's ལས་སུ་རུང་བ = kham nhậm.
p0096, བོགས་གཞན་དང་མི་འདྲ་བར་འོང་བ.

terms.vi: an trú nơi sự tiếp xúc với an lạc
terms.note: p0096. Rendered literally rather than smoothed to 'sống an lạc', because རེག་པ is in the Tibetan.
p0095, འདུལ་བ་ནས་གསུངས་པ་ལྟར. Bare 'Luật' — the text does not write འདུལ་བའི་སྡེ་སྣོད, so 'Luật tạng' was not used.

p0093, `ཡུལ་དྲུག་ལ་མཚན་མར་... མི་འཛིན`, `མཚན་མར་འཛིན་པ་ནི།` (lines 17, 21). No glossary entry exists. Needs an explicit ruling because 'tướng' is already the provisional Vietnamese for `མཚན་ཉིད` (lakṣaṇa), so two distinct Tibetan terms currently collapse onto one Vietnamese word. Suggested split: `མཚན་མ` nimitta = 'tướng'; `མཚན་ཉིད` lakṣaṇa = 'đặc tướng' / 'định nghĩa' per its existing note. Text kept as is.

p0093, `མངོན་རྟགས་སུ་མི་འཛིན`, `མངོན་རྟགས་སུ་འཛིན་པ་ནི།` (lines 18, 25). No glossary entry. Paired with `མཚན་མ` in the standard nimitta/anuvyañjana formula of sense-restraint; ruling wanted alongside the `མཚན་མ` entry. Text kept as is.

p0072-73. The Tibetan translates the questioner's name (drag shul can = Ugra, 'fierce'); Sanskrit name kept in transcription following the glossary practice for དབུ་མ་སེངྒེ / བཤེས་གཉེན་གསང་བ. ཞུས་པ = thỉnh vấn. Not verified against an existing Vietnamese edition — see flag.
p0073. Also cited on p0070 (chunk c022, not yet translated) — that chunk should follow this.
p0074, vocative in the Gaṇḍavyūha prose passage. Established Vietnamese form.
p0074, in ཀུན་ཏུ་བཟང་པོའི་སྤྱོད་པ = 'hạnh Phổ Hiền'.
p0074 verse.
p0071, སངས་རྒྱས་བཅོམ་ལྡན་འདས = 'đức Phật Thế Tôn'.
p0073. The third subdivision of བསམ་པས་བསྟེན་པའི་ཚུལ, announced at p0067 as བཀའ་དྲིན་རྗེས་སུ་དྲན་ཏེ་གུས་པར་བྱ་བ. རྗེས་སུ་དྲན་པ = tùy niệm throughout.
p0071. བསྡམ (from སྡོམ་པ) taken as restraint/guarding against recurrence, not as the noun 'luật nghi'.

p0073, སྲིད་པའི་རྒྱ་མཚོ = 'biển hữu' and སྲིད་པའི་བཙོན་ར = 'ngục tù của hữu'. Deliberately NOT 'sinh tử'/'luân hồi', because འཁོར་བ (luân hồi) occurs in the same list two clauses earlier and the two must stay apart.
p0074, twice (prose and verse). Also occurs on p0070 (c022).
p0074, དུས་གསུམ་གྱི་ཤེས་བྱའི་རྒྱ་མཚོ = 'biển sở tri của ba thời'.

terms.vi: tánh bình đẳng của các pháp

terms.note: p0074 verse. Rendered literally rather than with 'giác chi', to keep བྱང་ཆུབ = bồ-đề visible per the fixed glossary entry. See flag on the verb.
p0072, Ratnamegha quotation. ཚོགས = tư lương.
p0072, ཞེ་ས་དང་རིམ་གྲོ་བསྐྱེད — again paired with རིམ་གྲོ and so given a distinct word.
p0073, vocative in the Ugraparipṛcchā quotation.
p0072, contrasted with ཚུལ་ཁྲིམས་དང་ལྡན་པ = 'có giới hạnh'.
p0072, Serlingpa's tenet position, contrasted with དབུ་མ. རྣམ་བདེན = 'chân tướng' (true-aspect). See flag.
p0072, ལྟ་བ་དབུ་མ = 'kiến Trung Quán'. Bare དབུ་མ has no glossary entry yet.
Unruled, and it is the headword of this sa-bcad: བཀའ་དྲིན་རྗེས་སུ་དྲན་པ → `tùy niệm ân đức` (L83, p0073 l.3). Needs a fixed rendering because the heading recurs. Wording kept.
The six preparatory practices attributed to Serlingpa. Rendered descriptively rather than with 'gia hành', which would collide with སྦྱོར་ལམ (Gia Hành đạo) already used in c005.
Asaṅga's Śrāvakabhūmi, abbreviated ཉན་ས exactly as བྱང་ས (= Bồ-tát Địa, already in glossary) is. Cited at p0085 for the posture rules.
p0085, in the list གཉིད་རྨུགས / འདོད་པ་ལ་འདུན་པ — i.e. the five hindrances, not the general 'obscuration'. Kept distinct from སྒྲིབ་པ = chướng/nghiệp chướng used elsewhere in the glossary; see flag.

terms.vi: sự tham muốn đối với dục lạc
terms.note: p0085. Rendered as a phrase rather than the compact 'dục tham' so the Tibetan structure (འདུན་པ towards འདོད་པ) stays visible.
p0085. Components taken one by one: རྒྱ་ཆེན = quảng, སྤྱོད་པ = hạnh. The source does not gloss the lineage name.
p0085. ཟབ་མོ = thâm, ལྟ་བ = kiến (per the glossary's provisional ལྟ་བ entry). Paired with the Quảng Hạnh lineage in the same sentence.
p0085, last member of the merit-field list. Literally 'those who abide by the command'; rendered with the established Vietnamese 'hộ pháp'.
p0085. 'tích tập tư lương' matches c010's wording for ཚོགས་བསག. 'phước điền' deliberately avoided — the Tibetan has no བསོད་ནམས here.
p0085, contrasted in the same sentence with ཉེར་ལེན་གྱི་རྒྱུ. See flag — this is a technical Abhidharma pair and 'trợ duyên' is the plain rendering, not a settled equivalent.
p0085. The substantial cause, opposed to ལྷན་ཅིག་བྱེད་རྐྱེན.
p0085, contraction of དམིགས་པ + རྣམ་པ. Expanded to two Vietnamese nouns because the contraction has no Vietnamese equivalent.

p0085. Each limb is then named with ཡན་ལག: ཕྱག་འཚལ་བ = chi lễ lạy, མཆོད་པ = chi cúng dường, སྡིག་པ་བཤགས་པ = chi sám hối tội lỗi, རྗེས་སུ་ཡི་རང་བ = chi tùy hỷ, ཆོས་འཁོར་བསྐོར་བར་བསྐུལ་བ = chi khuyến thỉnh chuyển pháp luân, གསོལ་བ་འདེབས་པ = chi khẩn cầu.
Cited three times (p0086 ×2, p0088) as སློབ་དཔོན་ཡེ་ཤེས་སྡེ, author of the འགྲེལ་པ on the verses. Tibetan name left in transcription, as with Naktso and Drolungpa; སློབ་དཔོན = A-xà-lê, matching c005.

Used both as a verse incipit (p0086) and as a common noun in the gloss (ཡུལ་རྣམས་ཀྱི་བཟང་པོའི་སྤྱོད་པ). Rendered literally and identically in both places; the established 'hạnh Phổ Hiền' was NOT used because the source never names Samantabhadra or the prayer. See flag.

terms.vi: cúng dường hữu thượng / cúng dường vô thượng
terms.note: p0087. The whole passage turns on this contrast, which the text itself defines (hữu thượng = worldly offerings).
p0087. ཕུར་མ = heap/mound; the gloss covers both scattered fragrant powder pressed into burnable lumps and coloured maṇḍala powder. See flag on the scope of the Meru comparison.
p0087, in the gloss on དྲི་མཆོག: སྤོས་ཆུ་ཡོན་ཆབ་ཏུ་གསོལ་བ.
p0087, in the ཕྱེ་མ་ཕུར་མ gloss.
p0087. Kept short because the source writes only སྟོང་གསུམ, not the full སྟོང་གསུམ་གྱི་སྟོང་ཆེན་པོའི་འཇིག་རྟེན་གྱི་ཁམས.

p0086, in the negative: ...ལྟ་བུ་མིན་པར. Sense fixed from the parallel at p0365, where གཡམ་ལ་རྒྱུགས stands beside བསྐུལ་བ (being prompted) and སྲོལ་ཀ (mere custom) as ways of acting that are rejected. See flag.
p0088, གང་ཟག་ལྔ་པོ = 'năm hạng người'. Rendered plainly rather than 'bổ-đặc-già-la'; the passage is enumerative, not technical.

terms.vi: hộ trì / cách thức hộ trì
terms.note: No ruling exists. c027 announces this sa-bcad as 'cách thức hộ trì' (and 'chính cách thức hộ trì' for སྐྱོང་ཚུལ་དངོས།); c028's heading said 'hành trì' and has now been changed to 'hộ trì' to match the announcement. A third form is still live: c028 line 31 renders དམིགས་རྣམ་སྐྱོང་བ as 'duy trì sở duyên và hành tướng', where the sense is sustaining a meditation object rather than guarding a practice. A ruling should say whether སྐྱོང་བ is 'hộ trì' everywhere, or 'hộ trì' in sa-bcad/practice contexts with 'duy trì' licensed for sustaining an ālambana.

The verb the whole section 6.1.2.1 (སྐྱོང་ཚུལ་དངོས) is named for. Rendered 'duy trì' consistently, both for the outline phrases (སྤྱིའི་སྐྱོང་ཚུལ = 'cách duy trì nói chung') and for the verb taking the meditation object (དམིགས་པ་ལ་བསྐྱངས་ན). c027/c028 are not yet translated, so this is the first fixing; whichever chunk translates the section heading should follow it.
Limb of the seven-limb practice; བསྔོ་བའི་ཡན་ལག = 'chi hồi hướng'. Kept as bare 'chi' so the seven are countable.
p0091, paired with བཟང་པོ་སྤྱོད་པ. No established Vietnamese title found, so rendered literally rather than with a Sino-Vietnamese coinage (Thất Thập Nguyện).

p0091, in བྱིང་རྒོད and again in བྱིང་རྨུགས. The source itself distinguishes བྱིང་ from རྨུགས in the same paragraph, so the two must not collapse: བྱིང་བ = 'trầm một' (沉沒), རྨུགས་པ = 'hôn trầm' (昏沉). Recurs several hundred times in the śamatha division. See flag.
p0091, བྱིང་རྒོད = 'trầm một và trạo cử'.
p0091, བྱིང་རྨུགས = 'trầm một và hôn trầm'. Kept apart from བྱིང་བ on purpose.
The break between sessions; heading-like phrase ཐུན་མཚམས་ལ་ཇི་ལྟར་བྱ་བ.
p0090, ཚེ་ཧྲིལ་པོའི་དགེ་སྦྱོང་སྐྱོན་ཅན་དུ་འགྲོ — 'đời sống sa-môn của trọn một đời sẽ trở nên có lỗi'.

p0092. A name some teachers give to the triad (mind-training on the object, vows/precepts, accumulating the collections). Translated rather than transliterated because the text explicitly says it is a name being assigned (མིང་བཏགས་ནས).
Third of the ཚོགས་བཞི.
p0089, བདག་གཉིས་སུ་མཚན་མར་འཛིན་པ = 'chấp tướng nơi hai ngã'. The text does not enumerate the two, so neither does the Vietnamese. See flag.
p0089-0090, བདག་མེད་པའི་དེ་ཁོ་ན་ཉིད་རྟོགས་པ = 'chứng ngộ thật tánh vô ngã'. Kept off 'chân như', which belongs to དེ་བཞིན་ཉིད (tathatā).
p0091, the resolve to restrain oneself in future; kept distinct from སྡོམ་པ = luật nghi (glossary).
p0092, inside the སུམ་བསྒྲིལ triad. Rendered as two words because the compound joins སྡོམ་པ (luật nghi, glossary) and ཁྲིམས.
The offering maṇḍala. Same Vietnamese as the existing དཀྱིལ་འཁོར entry. The source spells it མཎྚལ (with ཊ), a common variant of མཎྜལ; not normalised.
p0092; རྣམ་པར་ཤེས་པ = 'thức', ཡུལ = 'cảnh', དབང་པོ = 'căn'.
p0092, of the six objects.

Currently glossed only incidentally, inside the ཐོས་པའི་ཚོམས title entry, which is what let 'đa văn' through at line 60. Needs a ruling of its own: bare ཐོས་པ = 'văn' (or 'nghe học' where a bare Sino-Vietnamese noun will not parse), and explicitly NOT 'đa văn' — 'đa văn' is reserved for ཐོས་པ་མང་བ / མང་དུ་ཐོས་པ (bahuśruta). ཐོས་པ recurs constantly in this section (văn-tư-tu triad).
Nāgārjuna's Letter to a Friend, cited twice at p0098. Established Sino-Vietnamese title (親友書) chosen, following the precedent set for མཛོད = Câu-xá and རྒྱུད་བླ་མ = Bảo Tánh Luận.
p0098. Follows c028, which already renders སྒྲིབ་པ in this Śrāvakabhūmi context as 'triền cái' ('triền cái thụy miên và hôn trầm'). Kept distinct from སྒྲིབ་པ = chướng elsewhere.
p0098-p0100, from མི་ཉལ་བར་རྣལ་འབྱོར་ལ་བརྩོན་པ. The fourth item of the between-session conduct; the whole passage turns on it, so it needs one stable form.
Not new wording — taken from c028 line 13 — but recorded because it now forms a fixed pair with ཐུན་མཚམས and the pair recurs.
p0099, first of the four attitudes for sleeping. འདུ་ཤེས = tưởng per the glossary. Rendered descriptively rather than with the Sino-Vietnamese 'quang minh tưởng'.
p0100, fourth of the four; parallel in form to སྣང་བའི་འདུ་ཤེས so the two are rendered on one pattern.

terms.vi: ngủ như sư tử / tư thế ngủ của sư tử
terms.note: p0099-p0100. The lion posture is glossed at length by the text itself, so it is rendered literally and not replaced by the Sino-Vietnamese 'sư tử ngọa'.
p0099. First occurrence in a translated chunk; glossary has no entry.
p0099, གཉིད་ཀྱིས་རྒྱས་པར་བྱ་བའི་འབྱུང་བ་རྣམས — the bodily elements replenished by sleep.
p0097, third of the five drawbacks of seeking food. Rendered with 'no đủ' rather than 'chán' because ངོམས is satiety with food specifically, which is the whole subject here.

terms.vi: sự tổn hoại tình thân ái
terms.note: p0097, second of the five drawbacks of seeking food.

terms.vi: lỗi của sự không có tự do
terms.note: p0097, fourth of the five drawbacks of seeking food.

p0100, བརྗེད་ངས་ནའང. Rendered non-technically; if the doctrinal sense (the mental factor of forgetfulness) is wanted elsewhere, 'thất niệm' — already used in c030 for དྲན་པ་ཉམས་པ — would collide, so the two are deliberately kept apart.

terms.vi: đấng có bản tánh chánh lý
terms.note: p0098, vocative opening the Suhṛllekha verse, addressed to the king. Rendered literally (རིགས་པ = chánh lý, བདག་ཉིད = bản tánh). See flag — the rendering is not verified against an existing edition.
p0099. Idiomatic adverbial use ('as a matter of course'), NOT the doctrinal ཆོས་ཉིད = pháp tánh. Recorded so the Phase 5 sweep does not read this as drift from a pháp tánh rendering elsewhere.

terms.vi: chuẩn bị / chính hành / kết thúc / khoảng giữa các thời khóa
terms.note: p0100, the four-part frame of a session, listed together in the closing sentence. སྦྱོར་བ = 'chuẩn bị' follows c028 ('các pháp chuẩn bị' for སྦྱོར་བའི་ཆོས). The four should be pinned centrally — they structure the whole of section 6.1.2.

terms.vi: thời khóa / khoảng giữa các thời khóa
terms.note: Structural to this whole section: ཐུན་མཚམས occurs six times (lines 64, 69, 74-75, 77, 133; p0098 l3, p0100 l1) and names what the passage is about; ཐུན་གྱི་ངོ་བོ is rendered "chính thời khóa". glossary.json has ཐུན་མོང་བ / ཐུན་མོང་མ་ཡིན་པ but no ruling for ཐུན or ཐུན་མཚམས — a different word that must not be attracted to the ཐུན་མོང་ entries. Needs fixing before it recurs across the śamatha material.

Only བརྩོན་འགྲུས (vīrya) = tinh tấn is fixed; the verbal cognate བརྩོན་པ has no ruling and this chunk had rendered it three ways (tinh tấn / sự siêng năng / nỗ lực). I have aligned all four occurrences to "tinh tấn" for intra-chunk consistency, but the ruling itself is open: a decision is needed on whether བརྩོན་པ collapses into tinh tấn (as done here) or is kept distinct from བརྩོན་འགྲུས — note line 83 has བརྩོན་འགྲུས་གཉིས = "hai sự tinh tấn" in the same chunk, so the two words now share one Vietnamese word.

terms.vi: chuẩn bị / chính hành / kết thúc
terms.note: Line 132-133 (p0100 l1), the three-part session structure that governs the whole section. No ruling for the triad; wording kept, but it recurs constantly and should be fixed as a set.

terms.vi: cách thức nương tựa bằng ý lạc
terms.note: Section heading 6.1.1.3.1. བསམ་པ = ý lạc (āśaya), consistent with the existing glossary entry ལྷག་པའི་བསམ་པ = tăng thượng ý lạc. བསྟེན་པ = nương tựa, per འདུ་ཤེས་དྲུག་བསྟེན་པ.

terms.vi: cách thức nương tựa bằng gia hạnh
terms.note: The paired heading 6.1.1.3.2, named in this chunk's introductory outline. སྦྱོར་བ = gia hạnh (prayoga).

Head term of section 6.1.1.3.1's second part (རྩ་བ་དད་པ་སྦྱང་བ). Kept as plain 'lòng tin' and deliberately distinct from the glossary's མོས་པ = 'lòng tin ưa'. Occurs ~20× in this chunk, mostly inside two verse quotations, so a compact form was needed.

Cited twice at p0068 (second time as མདོ་དེ་ཉིད = 'kinh ấy'). Used the established Vietnamese title (via 般舟三昧經) so readers can locate the work, per the precedent set for Câu-xá and Bảo Tánh Luận. The Tibetan title is descriptive: 'định trong đó chư Phật hiện tại hiện diện trước mặt'.
p0069. The source cites only the short name བརྒྱད་སྟོང་པ, so only the short Vietnamese title is used (not 'Kinh Bát Thiên Tụng Bát-nhã').
p0070, source of the eight-line faith verse. The Tibetan itself half-transliterates the Sanskrit (ཏ་ལ་ལ), so the Sanskrit is kept rather than coining a Sino-Vietnamese title. See flag.

terms.vi: Mật tục Quán Đảnh Kim Cang Thủ
terms.note: p0070, quoted at the very end of the chunk; the quotation runs on into c023. ལག་ན་རྡོ་རྗེ = Kim Cang Thủ; དབང་བསྐུར = quán đảnh, matching the glossary's དབང = quán đảnh.
Vocative opening the Vajrapāṇyabhiṣeka quotation. Established Sino-Vietnamese (秘密主), epithet of Vajrapāṇi. NOTE: the source spells it གསང་བ་བའི་བདག་པོ with an extra བ — see flag.
Kadampa master contrasted with Geshe Tönpa at p0067. Tibetan name left in transcription, as with Naktso and Drolungpa.
The source uses both the bare form སྤྱན་སྔ (p0068, p0069) and སྤྱན་སྔ་བ (p0068); one Vietnamese form used for both so the Phase 5 sweep sees a single name.
p0068. སྒོམ་པ treated as a title, as in the glossary's སྒོམ་པ་རིན་ཆེན་བླ་མ = Gompa Rinchen Lama.

p0068. NOT Atiśa: ཇོ་བོ here precedes a personal name, so it functions as an honorific on a different master. Deliberately 'ngài Jowo …' rather than the glossary's bare ཇོ་བོ = 'đức Jowo' (Atiśa), which is used unmodified elsewhere in this same chunk.
p0069. ལྷ་བཟོ literally 'image-maker'; treated as a personal name.
p0069, the ācārya who rebukes Geshe Lhazo at every meeting.
p0069, disciple of Geshe Lhazo.
p0069, in Lhazo's reply. Left in Sanskrit transcription.
p0070, twice (བོད and ཁྱེད་བོད = 'các ông người Tây Tạng'). Established Vietnamese name used rather than the transcription 'Bö'.
p0069, in Atiśa's remark.
p0068, སྤྱན་སྔ་བ་རུག་པ་ན་བཞུགས་ཙ་ན. Read as a place name and transcribed. See flag.
p0068. Indra's palace, used as the image of maximum comfort. Rendered from the Tibetan components (རྣམ་པར་རྒྱལ་བ = tối thắng, ཁང་བཟང = tòa lầu). See flag.
p0068, first of the six minds. Rendered literally; the established Vietnamese cosmological name 'núi Thiết Vi' adds 'iron', which the Tibetan does not say, and the simile turns only on immovability.
p0069, third of the six minds.
p0069 (×3, incl. ང་རྒྱལ་གྱི་སྒང་བུ) and p0070 in the Ratnolkā verse. See flag: the glossary already assigns 'ngã mạn' to ཁེངས་པ.
p0069, paired with bare ང་རྒྱལ. Rendered descriptively rather than with a fixed Sino-Vietnamese member of the seven-mān list, since the Tibetan compound is not one of the standard seven names.
p0070, in Atiśa's rebuke. Uses the glossary's འདུ་ཤེས = tưởng.
p0070, the logical figure by which the two sūtra quotations jointly establish faith as the basis of all qualities (positive concomitance in the first, negative in the second).
p0070, in the list of objects of faith. Kept distinct from the same syllables inside the title དཀོན་མཆོག་ཏ་ལ་ལའི་གཟུངས, which is left in Sanskrit.
p0070. Rendered from the Tibetan (བདེན་བཞི = four truths) rather than the expanded 'Tứ Diệu Đế', which adds a qualifier the Tibetan does not have.
p0067, the lay vow-holder Sangphuwa stopped to listen to.

terms.vi: các vị dịch giả và paṇḍita
terms.note: p0068–p0069, the standard contraction of ལོ་ཙཱ་བ + པཎྜི་ཏ. paṇḍita left in Sanskrit per the glossary's པཎྚི་ཏ entry (NOT 'ban-trí-đạt', which the glossary reserves for where the source transliterates the Sanskrit in Tibetan script).

terms.vi: trao mũi mình [cho ai dắt đi]
terms.note: p0068. Idiom for surrendering oneself to another's lead, from the pierced nose of a draught animal. Kept as the image with a bracketed supplement. See flag.
p0068, in the vajra-like mind and in the Pratyutpanna quotation (མཛའ་བ་མི་རྟག་པ).

No ruling for the bare word. Two issues to settle in one entry. (a) Scope: it must NOT be rendered 'thiện tri thức', which glossary.json fixes for དགེ་བའི་བཤེས་གཉེན — the two terms occur within three lines of each other on p0068 l.1, so collapsing them destroys the distinction; I changed c022 l.52 accordingly. As a Tibetan monastic title it is best transliterated. (b) Orthography: 'Geshe' (c022 l.15, 18, 71, 79) vs 'Geshé' with the acute (c021 l.76, c019 l.64). Both are live in the corpus and neither is registered; pick one and sweep. c022 was left as 'Geshe' pending the ruling.

Needed to break the collision with རིམ་གྲོ་བསྐྱེད་པ, which glossary.json already maps to the string 'khởi lòng cung kính'. Two further problems for the same headword: (a) glossary.json is internally inconsistent — the རིམ་གྲོ entry gives 'lòng tôn kính' / 'khởi lòng tôn kính' while the རིམ་གྲོ་བསྐྱེད་པ entry gives 'khởi lòng cung kính'; (b) the sa-bcad item བཀའ་དྲིན་རྗེས་སུ་དྲན་ཏེ་གུས་པར་བྱ་བ (p0067 l.7) appears in c022 l.28 as 'nhớ nghĩ ân đức mà tỏ lòng cung kính' but as the section title in c023 l.82 as 'Thứ ba, tùy niệm ân đức', which drops གུས་པར་བྱ་བ entirely. Outline and heading must be made to match; that fix belongs in c023.
The interlocutor of the tantra quoted at p0081.

p0081, ཤཱནྟི་པས་མཛད་པའི་དགྲ་ནག་གི་དཀའ་འགྲེལ. དགྲ་ནག ('kẻ địch đen') is the Tibetan name of Kṛṣṇayamāri; rendered literally as Hắc Địch because no Vietnamese title exists. དཀའ་འགྲེལ (pañjikā) = 'Nan Giải'. Śāntipa is already in the glossary.

terms.vi: bậc đại học giả thành tựu
terms.note: p0081, epithet of Śāntipa. མཁས་གྲུབ = scholar + siddha; rendered as a phrase rather than compressed, to keep both halves.
p0082. Cited by the bare Tibetan name; rendered with the standard Sino-Vietnamese 念處 without adding 'Chánh Pháp', which the source does not write.
p0081, in the Vajrapāṇyabhiṣeka verse མཚམས་མེད་ལ་སོགས་མི་བཟད་པ་དམྱལ་བ. Taken as a hell-name on the parallel with མནར་མེད་ལ་སོགས in the Gurupañcāśikā verse eleven lines later. See flag.

p0081, Gurupañcāśikā verse. Deliberately rendered A-tỳ, not Vô Gián, so that the source's use of two distinct Tibetan hell-names in two adjacent quotations survives in Vietnamese. Both are 無間 in Chinese; the split is a translator's device, not a doctrinal claim. See flag.
p0081, Gurupañcāśikā verse (བསད་ནས་སེམས་ཅན་དམྱལ་བར་འགྲོ). Rendered literally rather than flattened to 'địa ngục', since སེམས་ཅན is written.
p0081, the Kṛṣṇayamāri-pañjikā verse. Literally 'one having a mole/blemish'; the literal rendering would be unintelligible. See flag.
p0082, both the contracted and full forms, rendered identically.
p0082, in the Nirvāṇa quotation. Kept distinct from སྡིག་གྲོགས = bạn ác because the two words stand in different quotations on the same page and Phase 5 should not merge them.
p0082, contrasted in the same clause with ཤའི་ལུས = 'thân xác thịt'.
p0080 prose (ནད་དང་གདོན) and p0081 verse. Kept distinct from རིམས = dịch sốt and ཡམས = ôn dịch, which appear beside it in the Gurupañcāśikā verse.
p0081, Gurupañcāśikā verse, listed after གདོན. Rendered by the literal sense of the Tibetan; it may denote a class of obstructing spirits rather than human misleaders. See flag.
p0082, Satyakaparivarta verse: དགེ་བའི་བཤེས་ཀྱི་དུག་སྨན, the antidote that answers the 'snake' of the bad companion in the preceding line.
p0080, in the Potowa saying. སློག་པ = sheepskin coat, ཧྲུལ་པོ = tattered; the whole simile depends on the garment, so it is kept concrete.
p0080, Potowa's simile, opposed to སྦུར་མ = trấu (chaff).
Cited p0081, c026 line 61. Unregistered. Note the Tibetan says only "the Fifty"; "Tụng" is supplied by the translation and should be ratified or dropped by the ruling.
Cited p0081, c026 line 80, as the root text of Śāntipa's དཀའ་འགྲེལ. Unregistered.
c026 line 80-81, p0081 (དགྲ་ནག་གི་དཀའ་འགྲེལ by ཤཱནྟི་པ). Unregistered; also functions as a genre word (commentary on difficult points), so the ruling should say whether it is titled or glossed.

The compact counterpart of འཇོག་སྒོམ, which glossary.json already carries as 'tu theo lối an trụ' with the note that དཔྱད་ནས་བསྒོམ་ = 'quán sát rồi mới tu'. The compact noun དཔྱད་སྒོམ occurs 6× in this chunk as a technical term paired against འཇོག་སྒོམ, so it is rendered in the parallel descriptive form the glossary note anticipates. If a compact pair ('quán sát tu' / 'an trụ tu') is later preferred, both entries must move together.

p0106, in the mkhas pa / ku sa li contrast. The Tibetan is itself a transliteration of the Sanskrit, so it is kept in Sanskrit transcription rather than translated (contrast མཁས་པ = 'bậc học giả', rendered).

p0106 (source writes མ༌ཁོལ with a non-breaking tsheg). མ་ཁོལ recurs elsewhere in the corpus as དཔལ་ལྡན་མ་ཁོལ and མཁས་པ་མ་ཁོལ, confirming it is an author's name. Sanskrit kept in transcription, following c005's practice for Sanskrit names with no settled Vietnamese form. སློབ་དཔོན = A-xà-lê (c005 uses 'đại A-xà-lê' only for སློབ་དཔོན་ཆེན་པོ). See flag.

p0105: བློ་ཤུགས་དྲག་ལ་རྒྱུན་རིང་བའི་ཡིད་འཁུལ་ནུས་པ་རེ་དགོས. Sense taken from the three other corpus occurrences (p0084 གོ་སླ་ལ་ཡིད་འཁུལ་ཞིང; p0176, p0185 སྐྱབས་འགྲོ་ཡང་ཡིད་འཁུལ་བ་ཞིག་འོང), where it means 'convincing, taken to heart'. See flag.

The bare verbal noun, as against སོ་སོར་རྟོག་པའི་ཤེས་རབ = 'trí tuệ giản trạch' already in the glossary. Rendered 'sự giản trạch' / 'cửa giản trạch' so the bare form and the compound stay visibly one term.

p0105, in the desire/hatred simile: སྡུག་པའི་མཚན་མ་སྒྲོ་འདོགས་པ. Here it is the plain act of superimposing attractive features, not the technical 'tăng ích' of the emptiness chapters; the technical sense should get its own ruling when it arises.
p0108, listed beside ཉོན་མོངས = phiền não (glossary, fixed) and ཉེས་སྤྱོད.
p0108, third member of the list ཉོན་མོངས / ཉེ་བའི་ཉོན་མོངས / ཉེས་སྤྱོད.

p0108, the two sides in the gold-refining simile, matching ནག་པོའི་ལས་འབྲས / དཀར་པོའི་ལས་འབྲས = 'quả của nghiệp đen / nghiệp trắng' in the same sentence. Kept literal rather than moralised into 'bất thiện / thiện'.
p0106, སྤང་བླང་འབྱེད་པ = 'phân biệt thủ xả'. Same rendering already used in c005 for the Vinaya passage.
p0106, ལམ་ལ་ས་ཆོད་ཅི་ཡང་མི་འབྱུང. Recurs across the corpus (ལམ་གྱི་ས་ཆོད, སྒོམ་པའི་ས་ཆོད, ས་ཆོད་ཆུང་བ) in the sense of ground covered / measure of progress. See flag.
p0105, བློའི་འཛིན་སྟངས་ཤུགས་དྲག — the mind's mode of apprehension, contrasted in the same sentence with ཡུལ་གྱི་རྣམ་པ = 'hình tướng của đối tượng'.
p0108. Follows the glossary's ཏིང་ངེ་འཛིན = định.

terms.vi: bộ đại luận giải thích mật ý
terms.note: p0105 and, without ཆེན་མོ, p0107 (ཤིང་རྟ་ཆེན་པོའི་དགོངས་འགྲེལ). Built from the glossary's དགོངས་པ = mật ý; kept distinct from གཞུང་ཆེན་མོ = đại luận.
p0105, ཞེ་རྩིས་མེད་པ — rendered 'trong lòng chẳng hề coi trọng'.
p0107–p0108, the smith of the gold-refining simile, in Tsongkhapa's own prose and again in the Asaṅga quotation.

p0106 l3 (×2). No entry. Consistent with c026 line 80's 'bậc đại học giả' (for the intensified form), but unrecorded, and here it is one half of the technical contrastive pair with `ཀུ་ས་ལི`, so it needs pinning. Caution for the ruling: `མཁས་པ` also occurs in this same chunk in its ordinary adjectival sense 'skilled' — `མགར་བ་མཁས་པས` (p0107 l3) → 'người thợ rèn khéo léo' and `མགར་བའི་སློབ་མ་མཁས་པ` (p0108 l3) → 'khéo léo'. The entry should record the split (nominal 'bậc học giả' vs. adjectival 'khéo léo') deliberately, or the Phase 5 sweep will read the simile occurrences as violations.

p0106 l3, as `སློབ་དཔོན་མ་ཁོལ` → 'A-xà-lê Mātṛceṭa' (c033 line 46-47), citing the line `ཤེས་རབ་ནང་ན་ཀུན་མཁྱེན་ལྟར`. The Tibetan name is silently resolved into its Sanskrit equivalent; the identification is the standard one, but the conversion should be recorded as it was for Madhyamakasiṃha and Mitraguhya. `སློབ་དཔོན` → 'A-xà-lê' is consistent with the existing `སློབ་དཔོན་ཆེན་པོ` → 'đại A-xà-lê' entry, but `སློབ་དཔོན` alone also has no entry and could be added at the same time.

No entry, and c033 renders it two ways. Abstract/compound use: `དྲི་མ་མེད་པའི་ཤེས་རབ` (p0106 l3) → 'trí tuệ không cấu nhiễm' (line 44). Concrete use in the gold-and-silver simile: `དྲི་མ་དང་སྙིགས་མ་ཐམས་ཅད་སྦྱངས` (p0107 l3), `དྲི་མ་དེ་དག་སྦྱོང` (p0108 l3), and inside the Asaṅga quotation (p0108 l3) → 'cấu bẩn' (lines 78, 84, 99). The split is defensible on register, but the simile is precisely the argumentative link between the two passages — the smith burns off the `དྲི་མ` of gold as analytical meditation burns off the `དྲི་མ` that keeps `དྲི་མ་མེད་པའི་ཤེས་རབ` from arising — so the shared word is load-bearing and the split rendering hides it. I have left both wordings pending a ruling. Note the standard Sino-Vietnamese for the compound is 'trí tuệ vô cấu', which would keep 'cấu' visible in both places; that is the kind of call that must be made centrally, not inside a repair.

terms.vi: Minh Cú (bộ thích luận về Ba-la-mật)
terms.note: p0103, source of the definition of སྒོམ་པ. Rendered from the Tibetan components (ཚིག་གསལ་བ = Minh Cú). Kept with the descriptive tag 'bộ thích luận về Ba-la-mật' because Minh Cú alone is the standard Vietnamese for Candrakīrti's Prasannapadā, a different work. See flag.
p0103. Kept distinct from the already-registered title མཛོད = Câu-xá; here the text names the Abhidharma generally, not the Kośa.
p0101, in the Sūtrālaṃkāra verse and its gloss. Built on the glossary's ཡིད་ལ་བྱེད་པ = tác ý.
p0101 verse (ཡང་དག་དོན་ཡུལ་ཡེ་ཤེས). Rendered 'trí' to keep it apart from ཤེས་རབ = trí tuệ, which occurs many times in the same passage.

terms.vi: trí tuệ do văn sinh ra / do tư sinh ra / do tu sinh ra
terms.note: The pivot of this whole chunk (16+ occurrences). Follows the descriptive form already used in translation/c011.md line 30-31 ('trí tuệ do văn và tư sinh ra', 'trí tuệ do tu sinh ra') rather than the compact Sino-Vietnamese văn/tư/tu sở thành tuệ. Bare བསྒོམས་བྱུང་ rendered '[trí tuệ] do tu sinh ra' with brackets.
p0101. ལུང་ kept as 'giáo điển' so it stays distinct from གསུང་རབ = thánh giáo, which appears twice in the same chunk.
p0101 and p0104, in the Hashang position ('all conceptions are apprehension of signs'). Kept distinct from སོ་སོར་རྟོག་པ = giản trạch, which shares the root but is the thing being defended.
p0101, p0104. Note the collision risk with the glossary's མཚན་ཉིད = tướng; these are different words and both come out 'tướng' in the compound.
p0101 and p0103, both times of the opponent's position. One rendering kept for both so the sarcasm of the second ('the càn bậy would become well-spoken') lands.
p0104, ལོག་རྟོག་གི་ཐ་ཆད. Read as 'the lowest/basest' from the corpus parallels བྱིས་པའི་ཐ་ཆད (p0248), ཤིན་ཏུ་ཐ་ཆད་པ (p0823) and ལོག་རྟོག་གི་ཐ་ཆད (p0935, identical phrase). See flag.
p0103, བསམ་གཏན་དང་པོའི་ཉེར་བསྡོགས = 'cận phần của tĩnh lự thứ nhất'. Uses the glossary's བསམ་གཏན = tĩnh lự.
p0103. See flag on the clause it sits in.
p0103-p0104. Load-bearing: the argument is that the translators rendered bhāvanā sometimes སྒོམ་པ and sometimes གོམས་པ, and that the two are one in meaning. One Vietnamese word each, kept apart.
p0103-p0104. Note that where the same phrase is being discussed AS a translator's choice ('có khi dịch là tu đạo'), the same Vietnamese is used.
p0104, Maitreya verse. ངེས་འབྱེད་ rendered 'quyết trạch', matching the glossary's གཏན་ལ་དབབ་པ = quyết trạch.
p0104, Maitreya verse and its gloss.
p0104, Maitreya verse and its gloss. Kept distinct from སོ་སོར་རྟོག་པ = giản trạch.
p0104, in the Śikṣāsamuccaya quotation and its gloss.
p0104. The quotation itself says བསོད་ནམས (phúc đức); the gloss substitutes དགེ་རྩ. Both translated as written, not harmonised.

KEPT (no ruling), but note that 'chánh' is a qualifier the Tibetan does not have (c032 line 34, in ལུང་དང་རིགས་པས). Plain 'chánh lý' is the conventional Sino-Vietnamese pairing with 'giáo điển'; if the glossary prefers a literal rendering, 'chánh lý' should be changed to 'lý' / 'lý lẽ' book-wide, not in this chunk alone.
Settled de facto — consistent with c001, c004, c005, c007, c010, c011, c022; c032 lines 24 and 65. Listed only so it gets recorded centrally.

Cited twice on p0114. Rendered literally from the Tibetan short title (སློབ་ = đệ tử, སྤྲིངས = thư gửi). No settled Vietnamese title found; the work is Candragomin's Śiṣyalekha, and the glossary already has him as 'đại A-xà-lê Candragomin'.

Cited at p0114. Title translated literally (མངལ་ = thai, འཇུག་པ = nhập). The source writes only མངལ་དུ་འཇུག་པ without མདོ; 'Kinh' supplied because the Vietnamese needs a genre word to read as a title.

p0115. འཕགས་པ = Thánh, དཔའ་བོ = Dũng — the established Sino-Vietnamese form 聖勇. Same author as the སྐྱེས་པའི་རབས / སྐྱེས་རབས (Bổn Sinh) already in the glossary; cross-link them so a later chunk does not split the person from the work.
p0116, the Kadampa master Dromtönpa addresses. Tibetan name left in transcription, as with Naktso, Drolungpa, Gönpawa.

The physical basis/support for practice — the pivot of this whole section, occurring 11× in p0114–p0116 (རྟེན་བཟང་པོ, སྡོམ་པའི་རྟེན, ལམ་བསྒྲུབ་པའི་རྟེན, ཁམས་གོང་མའི་རྟེན…). Follows c005.md, which already renders རྟེན as 'thân y'. A central ruling is needed because 'sở y' was the natural alternative and c028 uses 'sở y' for རྟེན in the sense of a physical representation (statue/text), a different sense.
Paired with ངན་འགྲོ in this chunk; 趣 = thú, matching འགྲོ་བ in བདེ་འགྲོ་ནི་མིའི་འགྲོ་བའོ ('thiện thú chính là thú của loài người').
p0114. 傍生, the Abhidharma register, rather than the colloquial 'súc sinh'.

The unfree states, opposite of དལ་བ. Rendered from the glossary's decision that དལ་འབྱོར = 'tám tự do và mười thuận duyên', i.e. དལ་བ = tự do; so མི་ཁོམ་པའི་གནས = 'chốn không có tự do'. The Sino-Vietnamese 'vô hạ' (無暇) was not used because it would break the visible link to the section's own headword.
p0115. The established Vietnamese name of the northern continent; the Tibetan is a translation ('unpleasant sound'), so the Vietnamese follows the Sanskrit-derived convention instead.
p0116, paired with ངེས་ལེགས. Established Lamrim Sino-Vietnamese pair (增上生 / 決定勝).
p0116, paired with མངོན་མཐོ.
p0116, ཐུགས་དམ་ལ་འཇུག་རེས་ཀྱིས / ཐུགས་དམ་མཛད་པ — Chengawa's regular meditation commitment. Honorific; rendered descriptively because Vietnamese has no compact equivalent.
p0115, in the Āryaśūra verse.

p0115, རིག་སྔགས་ཀྱིས་རྨོངས་པར་བྱས་པ — stupefied by a spell. The Bodhicaryāvatāra verse quoted just after has the bare སྔགས, rendered 'chú thuật' there to keep the verse from acquiring a word it does not have.

p0114 Śiṣyalekha verse, in the list ལྷ / ཀླུ / ལྷ་མིན / མཁའ་ལྡིང / རིག་འཛིན / མི་འམ་ཅི / ལྟོ་འཕྱེས. The whole list is rendered with the established Vietnamese names of the eight classes rather than literally, since the Tibetan names are themselves calques.
Same list, p0114.
Same list, p0114. Literal Tibetan is 'belly-crawler'.
Same list, p0114. Kept distinct from རིག་སྔགས = minh chú in the same chunk.
Same list, p0114.
p0114 Śiṣyalekha verse, བདེ་གཤེགས་ལམ་རྟེན.
p0114 (and p0113), ཆོས་བསྒྲུབ་པའི་ཆ་རྐྱེན — the contributory condition for practising Dharma. Kept distinct from རྒྱུ = nhân.

terms.vi: cứu cánh / giai đoạn trước mắt
terms.note: p0116, the contrastive pair མཐར་ཐུག་ལ་ལྟོས་ཏེ … གནས་སྐབས་ལ་ལྟོས་ནས. Recorded as a pair so the two are never rendered with the same word.
p0115, མི་ཁོམ་པའི་གནས་ཀྱི་འཕྲང་མང་པོ — the many narrow/dangerous defiles of the unfree states.
p0116, ཆུད་གཟན་ན — to squander/let go to waste.
p0116, in the Bodhicaryāvatāra verse. Discouragement shading into slackness; 'biếng trễ' keeps both without adding 'giải đãi', which is the term for ལེ་ལོ.
p0115, ལམ་ལ་སྦྱངས་པའི་བག་ཆགས་འཐུག་པ.

terms.vi: có tự do và thuận duyên (as rendered in c036 l.104)
terms.note: Glossary rules only the contracted དལ་འབྱོར ('tám tự do và mười thuận duyên', fixed). p0116 has the uncontracted དལ་བ་འབྱོར་པ་མིའི་ལུས་ཐོབ་པ in Tönpa's spoken question, rendered 'thân người có tự do và thuận duyên' — the numerals dropped, because the uncontracted form is adjectival and spoken, and 'thân người có tám tự do và mười thuận duyên' is heavy in direct speech. The same chunk's heading and opening (l.19, l.21) correctly use the numeral phrase for དལ་འབྱོར. Phase 5 will read the two as drift. Ruling needed: does the uncontracted form take the numeral phrase, the bare one, or does it follow register (heading/prose vs. quoted speech)?

Arising from the fabrication fixed above. There is no glossary entry for བདེན་པ at all (only the title བདེན་པ་པོའི་ལེའུ), so nothing licensed the narrower 'chân đế'. The chunk now reads 'lần đầu thấy được chân lý' for དང་པོར་བདེན་པ་མཐོང་བ. A ruling is needed on བདེན་པ generally and on this idiom in particular — the alternative standard rendering is 'kiến đế' — since it recurs wherever the path of seeing is discussed.

Counterpart of the fixed དལ་འབྱོར = 'tám tự do và mười thuận duyên'. Deliberately NOT the established Sino-Vietnamese 'bát nạn' / 'vô hạ', because the passage turns on the lexical link མི་ཁོམ་པ་བརྒྱད་དང་བྲལ་བ་ནི་དལ་བའོ ('lìa khỏi tám cảnh không tự do chính là tự do') and on the Suhṛllekha commentary's gloss དགེ་བ་བྱ་བའི་དལ་བ་མེད་པ. 'cảnh' is a supplied Vietnamese classifier, licensed by གནས་བརྒྱད་པོ in that same gloss. Singular མི་ཁོམ་པ = 'không tự do'; ཁོམ་པ (verse) = 'sự tự do'.
Section heading 6.2.1. རྟེན = 'thân y', following c005. Combines with the fixed དལ་འབྱོར rendering.
Heading 6.2.1 and its second sub-branch སྙིང་པོ་ཇི་ལྟར་ལེན་པའི་ཚུལ.
Commentary on the Suhṛllekha, cited twice on p0112. བཤེས་སྤྲིངས itself is already *Thân Hữu Thư* in c031; only the commentary is new.

terms.vi: Thuyết về Tám Cảnh Không Tự Do
terms.note: Cited at p0112 as a source disagreeing with the Suhṛllekha commentary about which gods are the long-lived ones. Title rendered literally from the Tibetan components (གཏམ = thuyết) so it stays visibly tied to the term མི་ཁོམ་པ་བརྒྱད. See flag — no settled Vietnamese title was found.
The four assemblies, used twice (definition of མཐའ་འཁོབ and of དབུས).
p0111 Suhṛllekha verse, མཐའ་འཁོབ་ཏུ་ཀླ་ཀློར་སྐྱེ་བ.
Fourth self-endowment; glossed in the text as not having committed or caused the ānantarya deeds. See flag: མཐའ is not separately rendered.
Fifth self-endowment. གནས is glossed in the text as 'the base from which all white dharmas arise', i.e. the vinaya (here meaning all three piṭakas), so 'nền tảng' rather than 'xứ' or 'trú xứ'.

terms.vi: thuận duyên nơi tự thân / thuận duyên nơi kẻ khác
terms.note: The five self- and five other-endowments. Built on the fixed དལ་འབྱོར rendering, where འབྱོར་པ = thuận duyên.
Uses the glossary's འདུ་ཤེས = tưởng.
The fourth-dhyāna god realm in whose outskirts the Non-Perceiving gods dwell. Established Sino-Vietnamese (廣果).
In the simile གྲོང་ལས་དགོན་པའི་ཚུལ་དུ — a hermitage set apart from a village.
Cited as མངོན་པ་ནས་གསུངས at p0112. See flag: may be the Abhidharmakośa specifically, which the glossary already fixes as མཛོད = Câu-xá.
Literal (གྲངས་མེད་པ = vô số), not the transliterated 'a-tăng-kỳ', which the Tibetan does not have.
Uses the fixed ཐར་པ = giải thoát.
The seat of awakening. Established Vietnamese title used rather than a literal 'tinh túy của bồ-đề'. See flag.

terms.vi: hiện chứng viên mãn thành Phật

terms.note: Follows the pattern of the glossary's ལུང་གི་བསྟན་པ / རྟོགས་པའི་བསྟན་པ = 'giáo pháp thuộc phần giáo / phần chứng', but is a third term and kept distinct from both.
In དོན་དམ་པའི་དམ་ཆོས = 'Diệu pháp thắng nghĩa'.

NOT a translator error — the chunk follows each existing entry exactly. དམ་ཆོས at lines 96 (verse དམ་ཆོས་སྟོན) and 108 (དོན་དམ་པའི་དམ་ཆོས) renders 'Diệu pháp' per the FIXED entry; དམ་པའི་ཆོས at lines 54 (p0112 གསུམ་པ་ནི་དམ་པའི་ཆོས་ལ་མི་མོས་པའོ), 105 (དམ་པའི་ཆོས་སྟོན་པ་ནི) and 112 (དམ་པའི་ཆོས་མངོན་སུམ་དུ་བྱ་བ) renders 'Chánh pháp' per the PROVISIONAL entry, whose own note asks for a ruling. The result is one compound rendered two ways within twenty lines (corpus-wide 8 vs 7). The conflict is aggravated because the fixed-set ཆོས entry and the ཆོས་སྤོང་བ entry both state 'chánh pháp is NOT licensed'. Recommendation from the Tibetan: དམ་པའི་ཆོས and དམ་ཆོས are the same compound (uncontracted vs contracted), so they should collapse to ONE Vietnamese term — 'Diệu pháp', following the fixed entry and consistent with the two 'chánh pháp is not licensed' notes. That would mean re-rendering lines 54, 105, 112 here and 8 sites corpus-wide, plus the title དམ་པའི་ཆོས་པདྨ་དཀར་པོ. Left unchanged pending the central ruling, as instructed.

Heading at line 21 and line 18. Bare རྟེན has no entry (only འཇིག་རྟེན and མཆོད་རྟེན are registered). 'thân' supplies 'body', which རྟེན alone does not say — a neutral 'sở y' or 'thân sở y' may be preferable. The heading recurs throughout the chapter, so fix it centrally. Kept as-is here.

p0122, འཇིག་རྟེན་ཕྱི་མའི་མཐོ་རིས་ཀྱི་ཕུན་སུམ་ཚོགས་པ. Rendered literally rather than 'cõi trời'/'thiên giới', which would narrow it to the deva realms; in the three-capacity scheme མཐོ་རིས covers human rebirth too. See flag.
p0122–p0123, three times: X དངོས་སམ་X་དང་ཐུན་མོང་བའི་ཆོས་སྐོར་དུ་འདུ. The class/cycle of teachings belonging to a given capacity.
p0123. Contracted form of the glossary's རྣམ་པ་ཐམས་ཅད་མཁྱེན་པ; same Vietnamese.
p0123 verse and p0124. Synonym in sense of སྐྱེས་བུ་ཆུང་ངུ = bậc hạ (fixed), but a different Tibetan word; rendered differently so the two stay traceable. Forms a triad with འབྲིང and མཆོག.
p0123 verse, p0124. Kept apart from སྐྱེས་བུ་ཆེན་པོ = bậc thượng (fixed) for the same reason; also distinct from སྐྱེ་བོ་མཆོག = bậc thượng nhân (glossary).
p0123, Atiśa's work, cited as ཇོ་བོས་སྤྱོད་བསྡུས་སྒྲོན་མ་ལས. Title translated from its Tibetan components (སྤྱོད = hành, བསྡུས = nhiếp, སྒྲོན་མ = đăng), matching the treatment of *Bồ-đề Đạo Đăng*.
p0124. Section of the Yogācārabhūmi. Built on the glossary's གཏན་ལ་དབབ་པ = quyết trạch.
p0124. Formed from the glossary's མཛོད = Câu-xá plus འགྲེལ = thích.
p0124, སློབ་དཔོན་དབྱིག་གཉེན = 'A-xà-lê Thế Thân'. Established Vietnamese name.
p0125, སློབ་དཔོན་རྟ་དབྱངས. Established Vietnamese name.

terms.vi: Tu Tập Thế Tục Bồ-đề Tâm
terms.note: p0125, Aśvaghoṣa's work. Title translated from the Tibetan components (ཀུན་རྫོབ = thế tục, བསྒོམ་པ = tu tập); no established Vietnamese title found.
p0125, Bhāvaviveka. Established Sino-Vietnamese title (中觀心論).
p0125 verse, ངེས་འབྱུང་ལམ་གྱི་ཡན་ལག and ངེས་འབྱུང་མཆོག་གི་སྤྱོད་པ. Matches c022's existing 'xuất ly'.
p0125 verse. Same Vietnamese as c028's 'núi Tu-di' (there for རི་རབ); the Tibetan words differ.

The chunk's own section headword (སྙིང་པོ་ཇི་ལྟར་ལེན་པའི་ཚུལ, and the parent 6.2.1 དལ་བའི་རྟེན་ལ་སྙིང་པོ་བླང་བ). c021 already has 'nhận lấy tinh yếu' for a different phrase — a ruling is needed so tinh túy / tinh yếu do not both float.
p0122, ལམ་སྤྱིའི་རྣམ་གཞག in the section heading 6.2.2.1.
p0124, སྐྱེས་བུ་གསུམ་གྱི་ཐ་སྙད. Here the sense is 'the term/designation', not the doctrinal 'conventional'.
p0123. Built on the glossary's སྙིང་རྗེ = bi; 'từ bi' not used, since the text does not pair it with བྱམས་པ here.

p0125, འགྲོ་ལ་སྙིང་རྗེའི་ཆུ་རྒྱུན་འབྱུང. Kept as rendered (no ruling exists), but it collides with the fixed rendering of སེམས་ཅན (count 382) and will read as a false consistency hit in Phase 5. A ruling is needed on whether འགྲོ / འགྲོ་བ gets its own Vietnamese (e.g. 'hữu tình') or is deliberately merged.
