p0186, the principal referent of དགེ་འདུན. Composed from the glossary's འཕགས་པ = bậc thánh and གང་ཟག = hạng người; the literal compound ('các hạng người thánh') is unusable in Vietnamese, so the established compound 聖人 is used. གང་ཟག alone is still rendered 'hạng người' later in the same chunk.
p0186, three times inside the Dharmasaṃgīti quotations (ཆོས་ཀྱི་སྤྱོད་ཡུལ, ཆོས་ཀྱི་སྤྱོད་ཡུལ་བ, དབེན་པའི་སྤྱོད་ཡུལ་བ). 行境. Kept distinct from ཡུལ and from སྤྱོད་པ = hành.

p0188, twice in Thù Thắng Tán verses (མུ་སྟེགས་གཞན་གྱི་གཞུང་ལུགས and ཁྱོད་ཀྱི་གཞུང་ལུགས). Deliberately NOT 'tông nghĩa', which c005/c008 assign to གྲུབ་མཐའ — and གྲུབ་མཐའ occurs four lines later in this same citation, so the two had to stay separable.

terms.vi: sự nhập vào và sự quay lui
terms.note: p0188, Varṇārhavarṇastotra verse. Rendered from the Tibetan components rather than with the doctrinal pair 'lưu chuyển / hoàn diệt', which would import more than the verse says.
p0188, twice (prose ཉོན་མོངས་རྣམ་པར་བྱང་བར་བྱེད་པ and verse རྣམ་བྱང). Paired with the glossary's ཀུན་ནས་ཉོན་མོངས་པ = tạp nhiễm.
p0188 verse. Already used this way in c005 and c019 but not registered in glossary.json.

terms.vi: đấng Sư Tử trong hàng thuyết giả
terms.note: p0188, metrically shortened to སྨྲ་བའི་སེང in the Thù Thắng Tán verse. Kept distinct from the glossary's སེང་གེ entries, which concern the lion sleeping posture.
p0187, the practice appropriate to the Dharma jewel. སྦྱོར་བ = gia hành per the glossary's prayoga entry; རྣལ་འབྱོར = du-già per བླ་མའི་རྣལ་འབྱོར.

terms.vi: Quy y do biết sự khác biệt
terms.note: Second of the four in the བསྡུ་བ list. Wording taken unchanged from c056, which announced all four; registering it so the heading and the announcement cannot drift apart.
Third of the four; wording taken unchanged from c056's announcement.

terms.vi: Quy y do không tuyên xưng nơi nào khác
terms.note: Fourth of the four; wording taken unchanged from c056's announcement.

Three distinct Tibetan words collapse onto one Vietnamese word inside this chunk: ཕྱི་པ (p0187 l.5) at l.70, མུ་སྟེགས (p0188, Viśeṣastava verse) at l.85, ཕྱི་རོལ་པ (p0188 prose) at l.99. None is registered. Wording kept — no ruling exists to depart from — but per decisions.md §5, where four near-synonyms were deliberately split to stay separable, one entry should cover all three and decide whether they merge or split (e.g. ཕྱི་པ / ཕྱི་རོལ་པ = 'ngoại đạo', མུ་སྟེགས = 'ngoại đạo' or a distinct rendering). Note l.85 also adds plural marking 'các phái' for མུ་སྟེགས་གཞན, harmless once the term is ruled.

p0186 l.1, at l.21. The components are ruled separately (འཕགས་པ = 'bậc thánh', གང་ཟག = 'hạng người', both provisional) but the compound is not, so the chunk is internally inconsistent about གང་ཟག: bare གང་ཟག is 'hạng người' at ll.56, 58, 59 (p0187 l.1). Wording kept; a compound entry is needed to settle whether it should read 'các bậc thánh' / 'các hạng người thuộc bậc thánh' instead.

p0188, vocative epithet of the Buddha in the Varṇārhavarṇastotra verse (དེ་ཉིད་དཔའ་བོ་ཁྱོད་བཀའ་དང), at l.111. The glossary has དཔའ་བོ = 'Dũng' only inside the personal name འཕགས་པ་དཔའ་བོ = 'bậc Thánh Dũng', so the bare epithet is unruled. Wording kept.
p0188, verse (དེ་ལྟ་དེ་ལྟར་མགོན་ཁྱོད་ལ), at l.87. Unregistered; agrees with c059 l.17 (མགོན་པོ → 'đấng Cứu Hộ'), so an entry should cover both forms and fix whether the classifier is 'bậc' or 'đấng'.

terms.vi: Phật bảo / Pháp bảo / Tăng bảo
terms.note: p0186 l.3, at ll.38-39. glossary.json registers only དཀོན་མཆོག(་གསུམ) = 'Tam Bảo'; the three individual jewels are unruled. Wording kept.
In བདེ་ལེགས་ཐམས་ཅད་ཀྱི་རྩ་བ (section heading, p0207, twice). Kept apart from བདེ་བ = an lạc, which occurs repeatedly on p0208 in the same chunk.
p0209, cited twice. Established Sino-Vietnamese title (賢愚經). First occurrence in a translated chunk.

p0209, named alongside ལུང and མཛངས་བླུན as a source for gaining certainty. Rendered literally from the Tibetan components (ལས = nghiệp, བརྒྱ་པ = bách). Not verified against an existing Vietnamese edition — see flag.

p0209. Built on the pattern already fixed for བློ་གྲོས་རྒྱ་མཚོས་ཞུས་པ = Kinh Hải Tuệ Thỉnh Vấn: རྒྱ་མཚོ = Hải, ཞུས་པ = thỉnh vấn. Must stay distinct from that entry — this one has no བློ་གྲོས. See flag.
p0209, from the Vinayavastu (*Luật Sự*). གནག་རྫི = người chăn bò; དགའ་བོ left as the Sanskrit Nanda rather than calqued to 'Hoan Hỷ'.
p0209, one of three figures from the *Kinh Hiền Ngu*. Sino-Vietnamese calque of the Tibetan components (གསེར = kim, ལྷ = thiên). Unverified — see flag.
p0209. Calque of གསེར = kim, དབྱིག = tài/vasu. Unverified — see flag.
p0209. Calque of གླང་པོ = tượng (voi), སྐྱོང = hộ. Unverified — see flag.

p0209, as དེ་བཞིན་གཤེགས་པ་འཁོར་བ་འཇིག = 'đức Như Lai Câu-lưu-tôn'. NOT new wording — translation/c060.md l.25 already has 'đấng Đạo Sư Câu-lưu-tôn' for the same Tibetan at p0192 — but glossary.json has no entry. Established Sino-Vietnamese (拘留孫); note the Tibetan is itself a translated name ('destroyer of saṃsāra').

p0209, ཀླུར་སྐྱེ་བ = 'sinh làm loài rồng' and the triad inside the sūtra quotation. Bare ཀླུ kept as the plain Vietnamese 'rồng' while the compounds take the Sino-Vietnamese 'long tử / long nữ', because 'long' alone does not stand as a noun in Vietnamese. Cross-link to the glossary's ཀླུ་སྒྲུབ = Long Thọ.

p0208, in the list of མི་མཐུན་པའི་རྒྱུ (discordant causes) rejected as producers of happiness and suffering. The Sāṃkhya primal substance, not the ordinary sense 'chief'. Must not be confused with ཤཱཀྱའི་གཙོ་བོ (glossary, epithet). Unverified — see flag.
p0208, ནང་པ་སངས་རྒྱས་པ་ཐམས་ཅད་ཀྱི་ཡང་དག་པའི་ལྟ་བ. Consistent with the glossary's provisional ལྟ་བ = kiến.
p0208. Rendered so that ནང་པ (insider / inner) is visible rather than dropped; deliberately not 'Phật tử', which the glossary assigns to རྒྱལ་སྲས / སངས་རྒྱས་སྲས་པོ.

terms.vi: nghiệp là quyết định / nghiệp tăng trưởng lớn
terms.note: p0208, the first two of the four attributes of karma under 6.2.3.1.1.2.2.1.1. Not printed sa-bcad headings — they run inside the paragraphs — so they were kept in prose, not made into Markdown headings. The remaining two fall outside this chunk; register the pair now so all four come out matched.
p0209, the four-member set śīla / ācāra / ājīva / dṛṣṭi = giới, nghi quỹ, sinh kế, kiến. ཆོ་ག = nghi quỹ follows c007/c040. The same four recur on p0210, so a ruling here settles the next chunk too.
p0207. See flag — the reading of མཐའི་ is not certain.

terms.bo: སྤངས་པ / རྟོགས་པ (as the two constituents of the Dharma Jewel)
terms.note: p0207. Follows the glossary's སྤངས་རྟོགས = 'đoạn và chứng', split into two nouns because the Tibetan states each with its own relative clause.

NO entry (glossary has only ཀུན་དགའ་བོ = 'A-nan'). p0209 l.1, the cowherd གནག་རྫི་དགའ་བོ; c065 l.88 'người chăn bò Nanda'. Same category as འཁོར་བ་འཇིག: the Tibetan gives the translated name and the Vietnamese restores the Sanskrit. Kept.

NO ruling. The registered དཀོན་མཆོག = 'Tam Bảo' (provisional) cannot apply inside this compound. p0207 l.1, twice (སྐྱབས་དངོས་ནི་ཆོས་དཀོན་མཆོག; མཐའི་ཆོས་དཀོན་མཆོག). c065 l.17, l.20. Rendering is right; only the ruling is missing. Kept.

NO ruling. houseStyle declares register 'northern' but enumerates only two rules (sinh not sanh; phúc not phước), both of which c065 obeys ('phúc đức' l.79, 'sinh' throughout). Nothing covers tánh/tính or chánh/chính, and both forms are used corpus-wide ('tánh' in 24 chunks, 'chánh' in ~15). Left untouched deliberately: this needs a corpus-wide ruling and sweep, not a c065-only edit that would put this chunk out of step with 24 others.

terms.vi: tịnh trừ bằng bốn lực / bốn lực
terms.note: Section headword for 6.2.3.1.1.2.2.4. སྦྱང་བ here is purification of misdeeds, NOT the glossary's བློ་སྦྱང་བ = 'tu tâm'; 'tịnh trừ' follows the existing glossary entry བསག་སྦྱང = 'tích tập và tịnh trừ'.

terms.vi: hành trì sự phá trừ hoàn toàn
terms.note: p0251, first of the four powers as named in the ཆོས་བཞི་བསྟན་པའི་མདོ quotation. Rendered from the Tibetan components rather than importing a Sino-Vietnamese 'năng phá lực', which the Tibetan does not spell out. The commentary then glosses this power as འགྱོད་པ = hối tiếc.
p0251, second of the four powers. གཉེན་པོ = đối trị per the existing glossary entry.
p0251, third of the four powers.
p0251, fourth of the four powers. Deliberately NOT the glossary's རྟེན = 'thân y' (the physical basis for practice) — here རྟེན is the object one relies on in confession.
p0251, defines the first power (མི་དགེ་བའི་ལས་བྱས་པ་ལ་འགྱོད་པ་མང་བ). Kept as plain 'hối tiếc' and distinct from བཤགས་པ = sám hối, which is the ritual act.

SCOPING REQUEST, not a fresh coinage: glossary already has ཟིལ་གྱིས་གནོན་པ = 'vượt trội hơn' (p0079, a root of virtue outshining others). At p0251 the object is སྡིག་པ་བྱས་ཤིང་བསགས་པ — the four powers overpower accumulated sin — where 'vượt trội hơn' does not read. Rendered 'chế phục' twice in this chunk. A ruling is needed on whether the entry splits by sense.
p0251. No glossary entry; 'phóng dật' is already the corpus rendering (c023 l.39, in a near-identical phrase བག་མེད་པ་དང་ཉོན་མོངས་མང་བ་ལ་སོགས་པའི་དབང་གིས, and c026, c056).

terms.vi: nghiệp nhất định phải thọ / nghiệp bất định
terms.note: p0251, the definite/indefinite karma pair. Rendered descriptively; 'định nghiệp / bất định nghiệp' was the compact alternative but the Tibetan here is the plain verbal phrase.
p0251, inside the sūtra quotation. Built on the fixed བྱང་ཆུབ་སེམས་དཔའ = bồ-tát; སེམས་དཔའ་ཆེན་པོ has no entry and appears nowhere else in the translated corpus.
p0251, source of the four-powers passage. Title translated from the Tibetan components (བསྟན་པ = tuyên thuyết); no established Vietnamese title verified.
p0251, cited for its confession (བཤགས་པ). Established Sino-Vietnamese 金光明. The Tibetan names only གསེར་འོད་དམ་པ, so no 'Tối Thắng Vương' is added.
p0251, the Thirty-five Buddhas confession. Rendered as a plain number, not 'Tam Thập Ngũ Phật'.
p0251, named as the type of ཟབ་མོའི་མདོ་སྡེ to be recited. Follows the glossary rule that ཤེས་རབ = bát-nhã inside ཤེས་རབ་ཀྱི་ཕར་ཕྱིན and in cited titles; ཕར་ཕྱིན = ba-la-mật is fixed.
p0252, བདག་མེད་ཅིང་འོད་གསལ་བའི་ཆོས་ཉིད. No glossary entry. 'quang minh' chosen over 'tịnh quang' / 'sáng trong'.
p0251–p0252, the third of the six antidote practices and the subject of the whole Subāhuparipṛcchā citation (4×).

p0251–p0252, named as an example of a གཟུངས་ཁྱད་པར་ཅན. The hundred-syllable mantra; established Sino-Vietnamese 百字. Left without 'chú/minh chú' because the Tibetan supplies གཟུངས = tổng trì in the same phrase.

p0252, source of the list of dream-signs of purification. Follows the precedent of the glossary's དཀོན་མཆོག་ཏ་ལ་ལའི་གཟུངས = 'Đà-la-ni Ratnolkā' — i.e. titles take 'Đà-la-ni' even though the bare term གཟུངས is fixed as 'tổng trì'. སྐུལ་བྱེད = 'the one that urges' → Khuyến Phát. Text not identified; see flag.

p0252, སྡིག་པ་བྱང་བའི་མཚན་མ. Deliberately NOT the glossary's provisional མཚན་མ = 'tướng' (nimitta, the object-sign that is grasped) — the sense here is an omen/indication in dreams. Registered so the Phase 5 sweep does not read it as drift.
p0252, in the dream-sign list beside གླང་པོ = voi.
p0252, kṣīravṛkṣa in the dream-sign list. Rendered literally from the Tibetan.
p0250, Kadampa master in conversation with Puchungwa. Tibetan name left in transcription, as with Puchungwa and Sharawa.
p0250, in ngài Tönpa's saying, taken as a vocative addressing the followers of Jowo (Atiśa) — built on the glossary's ཇོ་བོ = 'đức Jowo'. Could instead name one individual; see flag.
Section headword ཁྱད་པར་སྟོབས་བཞིས་སྦྱང་བའི་ཚུལ (p0250 l.3, p0251) → 'bốn lực'. No entry. The four-power section recurs, so fix centrally.
p0251, first of the four powers (རྣམ་པར་སུན་འབྱིན་པ་ཀུན་ཏུ་སྤྱོད་པ). No entry. Wording kept.
p0251, གསེར་འོད་དམ་པའི་བཤགས་པ and སངས་རྒྱས་སོ་ལྔའི་སྒོ་ནས་ཀྱི་བཤགས་པ. The glossary registers only the compound title བཤགས་བསྟོད → 'Sám Hối Tán'; the bare verbal noun has no entry. Wording kept.

terms.vi: tội ác / ác nghiệp / nghiệp tội ác
terms.note: Unruled: the glossary registers only the compound སྡིག་གྲོགས → 'bạn ác'. c077 uses 'nghiệp tội ác' (l.22), 'ác nghiệp' (l.23, 28, 30, 34), 'tội ác' (l.65, 68, 92, 96, 99, 103). Distinct from མི་དགེ་བའི་ལས → 'các nghiệp bất thiện' (l.75), which is a different Tibetan word and should stay separate. Wording kept per the no-ruling rule; one ruling needed, ideally a fixed-set.

The གཟུངས entry rules for translation over transliteration but says nothing about whether a cited title is exempt. Live conflict: c022 l.91 *Đà-la-ni Ratnolkā* (justified — the Tibetan itself half-transliterates ཏ་ལ་ལ) vs c077 l.103, where སྐུལ་བྱེད་ཀྱི་གཟུངས is wholly Tibetan. I rendered it *Tổng Trì Khuyến Phát*. Needs an explicit ruling: titles follow the term ruling unless the Tibetan transliterates.

p0199. The glossary registers སློབ་དཔོན་མ་ཁོལ = 'A-xà-lê Mātṛceṭa' and bare མ་ཁོལ = 'Mātṛceṭa'. Here the epithet is དཔལ་ལྡན, rendered 'Cát Tường' following c005's 'đức Cát Tường Atiśa' for དཔལ་ལྡན་ཨ་ཏི་ཤ.

terms.vi: Tổng Trì Tiếng Trống Bất Tử
terms.note: p0201. Built from the Tibetan components: འཆི་མེད = bất tử, རྔ་སྒྲ = tiếng trống, གཟུངས = tổng trì (glossary). No 'Kinh' prefix added — the source writes only གཟུངས.

p0201. ཕར་ཕྱིན = ba-la-mật (glossary, fixed); བསྡུས་པ = tập. Deliberately NOT 'Nhiếp Ba-la-mật', because bare བསྡུ་བ is already rendered 'bộ Nhiếp' in c059 and the two titles stand two sentences apart in this chunk.
p0198, listed beside ཕར་ཕྱིན and བསྡུ་བ་བཞི. བྱང་ཆུབ = bồ-đề (glossary, fixed).

terms.vi: thế giới tam thiên đại thiên
terms.note: p0198. The glossary has only the short སྟོང་གསུམ = 'cõi tam thiên', recorded as kept short because the source wrote only སྟོང་གསུམ; here the source writes the long form, so the long Vietnamese is used.
p0198. Established Sino-Vietnamese transliteration; the Tibetan itself transliterates the Sanskrit.
p0200, standing alone (not as བྱང་ཆུབ་སེམས་དཔའ་སེམས་དཔའ་ཆེན་པོ). Kept distinct from the fixed བྱང་ཆུབ་སེམས་དཔའ = bồ-tát.
p0201, in the list of what may NOT be relied on. Left in Tibetan transcription as a proper name of the tradition; not translated as 'ngoại đạo', which renders མུ་སྟེགས་པ elsewhere.
p0200, twice (Potowa's censer image and Puchungwa's first offering). An aromatic herb used as incense; left in Tibetan transcription because no Vietnamese/Sanskrit equivalent is secure.
p0200, the middle step of Puchungwa's three offerings. Read as a compound incense name (བཞི་སྦྱོར = four-ingredient compound); reng-bu left in transcription. See flags — the reading is not secure.
p0200. Both are Sanskrit incense names that the Tibetan itself transliterates, so the Sanskrit is kept rather than substituting 'trầm hương' / an unverified Sino-Vietnamese resin name.
p0198, in ཐུད་ཀྱི་སྔོ་ས (the discoloured part of the thud). A Tibetan food; left in transcription rather than guessed at.
p0200, གསེར་སྲང་ཉི་ཤུ་རྩ་གཉིས = 'hai mươi hai lạng vàng'. Weight unit.
p0201, Pāramitāsamāsa verse (ཕུལ་གྱིས་བཅལ་བར་གཞལ་མི་ནུས). A small unit of dry/liquid measure; rendered descriptively rather than transliterated. See flags.

p0199 Varṇārhavarṇa verse. Rendered literally from the Tibetan (སྦྱིན = cúng thí, གནས = nơi/chỗ); 'phước điền' deliberately avoided — the Tibetan has no བསོད་ནམས here, and ཞིང (ruộng) appears separately two lines above.

No entry. 2x in this chunk (p0199 l3 and p0201 l7), both inside verse citations. Note 'quả' is supplied on top of vipāka - standard Vietnamese usage but unrecorded; a ruling on bare 'dị thục' vs 'quả dị thục' is owed.

No entry for bare ཞིང - the glossary has only the compounds བཀུར་བའི་ཞིང and ཚོགས་གསོག་པའི་ཞིང. It is this chunk's controlling metaphor (~10x: ཡོན་ཏན་གྱི་ཞིང, ཞིང་ས, ཞིང་གི་མཆོག, ཞིང་དམ་པ, ཞིང་གི་མཐུ, and ཞིང་ཐམས་ཅད = buddha-fields at p0200 l1, where 'ruộng' does NOT fit and 'cõi' was used). A ruling should cover both senses.
No bare entry, only བླ་ན་མེད་པའི་མཆོད་པ. High frequency throughout this chunk and the section.
No entry at all, despite being the subject of the whole section (p0201 l3, l5).

Bhāvaviveka's auto-commentary, cited at p0256 (རྟོག་གེ་འབར་བ་ལས). Rendered with the established Sino-Vietnamese title (思擇焰) so readers can locate the work, on the precedent of Bảo Tánh Luận / Kinh Bát Chu Tam Muội. Literal sense of the Tibetan: 'ngọn lửa của tư trạch'.
p0256, inside the Tarkajvālā quotation. The Tibetan translates the name ('tràng ngón tay'); established Vietnamese transliteration chosen for recognisability, on the precedent of འཇམ་དཔལ → Văn-thù.
p0256, twice. Tibetan translates the name ('kẻ thù chưa sinh'); established Vietnamese transliteration used, matching the other names in the same list.
p0256, third name in the Tarkajvālā list. Not identified; left as a bare transliteration of the Tibetan syllables rather than resolved to a Sanskrit form. See flag.

p0256, last name in the Tarkajvālā list. Tibetan translates the name ('không sầu não'); established transliteration used for consistency within the list. Identification as Aśoka is inference from the name, not stated by the text — see flag.

p0257, the king of the Samādhirāja narrative. Left in Sanskrit (as the glossary does for Sarvavaidalyasaṃgraha) rather than coined in Sino-Vietnamese; the Tibetan is literally 'do bậc dũng ban cho'. See flag.
p0257, the one the king killed. Left in Sanskrit for the same reason; the Tibetan is literally 'hoa – trăng đẹp'. See flag.
p0257, inside the Sarvavaidalyasaṃgraha quotation. Built on the glossary's འཇམ་དཔལ = Văn-thù; གཞོན་ནུར་གྱུར་པ rendered with the established 童子 = Đồng Tử rather than the literal 'đã thành thiếu niên'.

p0256, twice inside the Tarkajvālā quotation (རྒྱུར་གྱུར་པའི་སེམས་པས་མངོན་པར་འདུ་བྱས་པ / སེམས་པའི་ཁྱད་པར་གཞན). Rendered with the bare Abhidharma term 思 = tư; 'tâm sở' was NOT added because this is a quotation and the Tibetan does not have it. No glossary entry exists for སེམས་པ, which recurs throughout the karma division — a ruling is needed.
p0255–p0256, twice. Distinguished from plain ལོང = mù; དམུས carries the congenital sense.
p0257, in the Bodhisattvabhūmi report. Built from the glossary's སྡོམ་པ = luật nghi and བྱང་ཆུབ་སེམས་དཔའ = bồ-tát.
p0258, closing Udānavarga verse. Uses the glossary's དགེ་སྦྱོང = sa-môn; སྐལ་བ rendered 'phần' (share/lot), not upgraded to 'quả vị'.
p0258, twice in the closing verse, matching the prose རིགས་པའི་ཚིག just before it. Uses the glossary's provisional རིགས་པ = chánh lý.

KEPT (no ruling). All four in one list at p0256, c079 l.21 (`མ་སྐྱེས་དགྲ` again at l.23), inside the Tarkajvālā quotation. None is registered. TWO things need one ruling: (a) the Tibetan->Sanskrit resolutions themselves, per the `མ་ཁོལ` / Mātṛceṭa precedent; (b) the unexplained split INSIDE a single Tibetan list between Sanskrit transcription (Svaka — and, two lines later, Śūradatta / Supuṣpacandra) and established Sino-Vietnamese (Ương-quật-ma-la, A-xà-thế, A-dục). The split is defensible as 'use the Sino-Vietnamese form where one is established in Vietnamese Buddhist usage, Sanskrit otherwise', but that policy is nowhere written down and should be, since it will recur on every name list in the book.

KEPT. `ཐར་བ་ཡིན` (p0256, c079 l.27) and `ཐར་བར་འགྱུར` (p0257, c079 l.52). glossary.json fixes only the noun `ཐར་པ` (mokṣa) = 'giải thoát' (status: fixed); the verbal form has no ruling, and in both sites here the sense is escaping/getting out of a specific situation (the Avīci rebirth; this very life) rather than mokṣa as a state. Record so Phase 5's sweep does not score 'thoát ra' as drift against the fixed noun. IF the ruling is extended to verbal forms, BOTH sites must change together — c079 l.27 and l.52.

terms.vi: chân chánh (l.35, for ཡང་དག་པར) · chánh lý (l.83, 87, 91)
terms.note: KEPT — NOT a defect in this chunk. houseStyle declares register 'northern' but names only two rules (sinh never sanh; phúc never phước) and c079 violates neither (grep: zero 'sanh', zero 'phước'). 'chánh' vs 'chính' is unruled and already split corpus-wide: 'chân chánh' in c027/c031/c034/c037/c039/c056/c058/c072/c073/c078, 'chân chính' in c018/c055/c057/c059/c063. Pre-existing, not introduced here. Requesting a houseStyle ruling because a declared northern register with no chánh/chính rule will make the Phase 5 consistency sweep noisy across ~15 chunks; whichever way it goes, it is a corpus-wide sweep, not a c079 edit.

First member of the fourfold karmapatha frame གཞི / བསམ་པ / སྦྱོར་བ / མཐར་ཐུག, announced at p0215. The other three are already pinned (བསམ་པ = ý lạc, སྦྱོར་བ = gia hành, མཐར་ཐུག = cứu cánh). Rendered literally 'cơ sở' rather than the established Sino-Vietnamese 'sự' (事), which is opaque in isolation. c067/c068 (parts 1-2 of this same section) were not on disk when this was written — the four must be pinned as a set.
Fourth of the ten non-virtues. Bare 'nói dối' rather than 'vọng ngữ'.
Fifth of the ten non-virtues. The verb འབྱེད་པ / དབྱེ་བ in the same passage is rendered 'chia rẽ', so the noun and the verb stay visibly related.
Sixth of the ten non-virtues. The source alternates ཚིག་རྩུབ་པོ and ངག་རྩུབ་པོ (p0221) with no difference of sense; both are given the one Vietnamese so the alternation does not read as two terms.
Seventh of the ten non-virtues. Follows c074, written concurrently, which renders the same term 'nói lời tạp uế'. The variant ཚིག་བཀྱལ་པ (p0220) is given the same Vietnamese.
Ninth of the ten non-virtues. Kept as the Sino-Vietnamese 害心 so it stays distinct from ཞེ་སྡང = sân and ཁོང་ཁྲོ = phẫn nộ, both of which occur inside its own definition on p0223.
p0223, ཁོང་ཁྲོའི་རྒྱུ. Deliberately not 'sân', which is reserved for ཞེ་སྡང in the same sentence.
p0223, third of the five factors of གནོད་སེམས.
p0220, in the definition of the basis of harsh speech. Distinct from གནོད་སེམས = hại tâm, which is the ninth non-virtue itself.
p0222 (also p0215, in c067). Established Vietnamese title. The གཏན་ལ་དབབ་པ་བསྡུ་བ = Nhiếp Quyết Trạch already in the glossary is a section of this same work, so the two should be visibly related.
p0220. Built from the glossary's མཛོད = Câu-xá and མཛོད་འགྲེལ = Câu-xá Thích; རྩ་འགྲེལ = root text together with its commentary.
p0220. Short form of ལས་ཀྱི་ལམ; consistent with the glossary's དགེ་བཅུའི་ལས་ཀྱི་ལམ = mười thiện nghiệp đạo.
p0223, listed with རྒྱལ་པོ and འཁོར་རྣམ་བཞི (= bốn chúng, already in the glossary).
p0223. Established Sino-Vietnamese name of the highest desire-realm heaven.
p0223. Built on the glossary's ཚངས་པར་སྤྱོད་པ = phạm hạnh.
p0221, seventh basis of idle speech.
p0221. The active counterpart of the glossary's ལུང་ནོད་པ = thọ nhận khẩu truyền.
p0222, fourth of the five factors of བརྣབ་སེམས.
p0222, third of the five factors of བརྣབ་སེམས. Reading not secure — see flags.
p0221, first group of the seven bases of idle speech.
p0221, fifth basis of idle speech (talk of kings, ministers, countries, thieves).
p0221, མ་འབྲེལ་བའི་བྱུང་རྒྱལ་སྨྲ་བར་འདོད་པ — the motivation for idle speech.

terms.vi: không kham nhẫn / tâm không kham nhẫn
terms.note: p0223 l3. glossary.json fixes བཟོད་པ = nhẫn (fixed), but that entry targets the pāramitā and says nothing about the negated verbal use 'cannot bear [an injury]'. Text KEPT; a ruling is needed that the verbal form may take 'kham'.
p0220 l1. Names a recurring subsection of the karma chapter; no entry exists.
p0220 l5, p0221 l1. Two Tibetan variants used for the same non-virtue; one Vietnamese form used for both.
p0220 l1, p0221 l3. Two Tibetan variants, one Vietnamese form; recurring subsection heading.
p0220 l3, p0221 l1. Almost certainly the short form of གཏན་ལ་དབབ་པ་བསྡུ་བ = 'Nhiếp Quyết Trạch'. A short-form ruling is needed so the two do not read as different works.
p0223 l1. Sits oddly beside the glossary's འདོད་ལྷ = 'chư thiên cõi Dục' and བདུད་ཀྱི་རིས་ཀྱི་ལྷ = 'chư thiên thuộc dòng ma'; bare ལྷ needs a ruling.

terms.vi: Mức độ phát sinh ý lạc của bậc hạ
terms.note: Outline s088, path 6.2.3.1.2, level 4 → '#'. Built from the fixed སྐྱེས་བུ་ཆུང་ངུ = bậc hạ and the provisional བསམ་པ = ý lạc; ཚད rendered 'mức độ'.

terms.vi: Trừ bỏ tà chấp đối với điều ấy
terms.note: Outline s089, path 6.2.3.1.3, level 4 → '#'. Uses the provisional ལོག་རྟོག = tà chấp. Note the verb here is བསལ་བ (dispel) → 'trừ bỏ', deliberately kept distinct from དགག་པ (refute) → 'bác bỏ' in the glossary's note on the p0084 heading དེ་ལ་ལོག་རྟོག་དགག་པ.
p0259, same list. རྟོགས་བརྗོད = avadāna = 譬喻 'thí dụ'; བརྒྱ་པ = bách. See flag: this risks collision with the Vietnamese *Kinh Bách Dụ* (百喻經), a different work.

terms.vi: các truyện kể trong thánh điển Luật
terms.note: p0259, same list. འདུལ་བ་ལུང = the Vinaya scriptures; ལུང 'thánh điển' rather than 'Luật Kinh', which glossary.json already assigns to Guṇaprabha's འདུལ་བའི་མདོ. རྒྱུད་གླེང occurs only once in the whole corpus — see flag.
p0259. Contracted spelling of the already-registered དྲན་པ་ཉེ་བར་བཞག་པ = *Niệm Xứ*; same Vietnamese, recorded so the sweep does not read the two spellings as separate titles.
p0259, in the Suhṛllekha verse, opposed in the same verse to ལོག་པར་ལྟ་བ = tà kiến. Both forms already occur in the corpus (c065, c035) but neither is in glossary.json.
p0259, Suhṛllekha verse. Matches c035/c011 usage; kept as the exact mirror of ཡང་དག་ལྟ = chánh kiến.

p0259, in རྟེན་ཅིང་འབྲེལ་པར་འབྱུང་བ་ལས་གཉིས་རྒྱུ་དང་འབྲས་བུར་བཅས་པ. The same fixed phrase recurs at p0247 (རྟེན་འབྲེལ་ལས་གཉིས་རྒྱུ་དང་འབྲས་བུར་བཅས་པ), where the preceding verse contrasts དཀར་ནག — so 'the two karmas' = white and black. Left as bare 'hai nghiệp': the passage itself does not name which two. See flag.
p0260, both the full and contracted spellings within four lines. No occurrence anywhere else in the translated corpus, and no glossary entry.
p0261. Contracted form of སྲིད་པའི་རྒྱ་མཚོ, which the glossary already renders 'biển hữu' via the provisional སྲིད་པ = hữu. Recorded so the contraction is not read as a new term.

p0261, in the first objection. Rendered '[giới] cận trụ' with the bracket, because the Tibetan word alone names the observance, not the vow. 'bát quan trai giới' deliberately avoided: it supplies the count of eight, which the Tibetan does not have.

p0261, contracted form. Consistent with the registered སོ་སོར་ཐར་པའི་སྡོམ་པ = luật nghi biệt giải thoát and the title སོ་སོར་ཐར་པ = Biệt Giải Thoát. Here it is the vow-system, not the text, so it is left lower-case and unitalicised.
p0261, ལམ་བསྒྲུབས་ཀྱང་ས་ཆོད་ཆུང་བས་ན. Literally 'the ground covered is small'. Rendered idiomatically; see flag.
p0259 verse. No ruling; rendering looks sound. Paired with `བག་ཡོད` → `bất phóng dật`, which does match its entry.
p0259. No ruling; standard Sino-Vietnamese form.

p0260, occurring both in full (`གཟུགས་ཀྱི་སྐུ`) and contracted (`གཟུགས་སྐུ`) within four lines. No ruling; both rendered `Sắc thân`. A ruling should confirm the two forms collapse to one Vietnamese term.

p0240. Cited by the short Tibetan name ཀུན་ལས་བཏུས. The full Vietnamese title was used rather than the bare short form *Tập Luận*, which alone is not self-identifying. NOTE the divergent precedent: the glossary's མཛོད entry deliberately keeps the SHORT Vietnamese title (*Câu-xá*) for a short Tibetan citation, so a ruling is needed on whether ཀུན་ལས་བཏུས should likewise be shortened to *Tập Luận*. The book's FIRST occurrence is on p0239, i.e. in c073, not here — whichever form c073 uses should govern.
p0239-p0240. The noun འཕེན་བྱེད = 'dẫn nghiệp' (引業); the verb འཕེན་པ = 'dẫn phát'. Paired with རྫོགས་བྱེད throughout the section; the two must be fixed together.
p0239-p0240. The counterpart of འཕེན་བྱེད = dẫn nghiệp (滿業). Kept distinct from the glossary's རྫོགས་པའི་རིམ་པ = viên mãn thứ đệ.
p0240-p0241. Occurs both as the noun (ས་བོན + dị thục) and in the verb སྨིན་པ = 'chín muồi'. Already used in c047/c050 etc. but not registered.

terms.vi: nghiệp nhất định thọ [quả] / nghiệp không nhất định thọ [quả]
terms.note: p0240. The Tibetan writes only མྱོང་བ ('to experience') with no object; 'quả' is bracketed everywhere because Vietnamese 'thọ' cannot stand objectless.
p0240-p0241. The pair the Bổn Địa Phần and Nhiếp Quyết Trạch passages both turn on; the whole four-case analysis is unreadable if the two words are allowed to converge.
p0241, the first of the three divisions by time of ripening. 順現法受. The other two (སྐྱེས་ནས་མྱོང་བ, ལན་གྲངས་གཞན་ལ་མྱོང་བ) fall in c075 and should be fixed with it.

p0239, p0241. Used for an exhaustive four-way combination (done/accumulated etc.), not for the Madhyamaka tetralemma; rendered plainly rather than 'tứ cú' so it is not mistaken for the latter. Individual མུ rendered 'trường hợp' (མུ་སྔ་མ་གཉིས = 'hai trường hợp trước').

p0241. Rendered literally rather than as 'trộm cắp', following the Tibetan compound. First registered occurrence, though the ten non-virtues are enumerated earlier in the section (c070-c073, untranslated) — whatever those chunks use should govern.
p0241. The last of the four verbal non-virtues (綺語). The source spells བཀྱལ; the standard orthography is ངག་འཁྱལ — see flag. Not normalised in the source text.
p0241. Built on the glossary's སྡོམ་པ = luật nghi. Distinct from དབང་པོའི་སྒོ་སྡོམ་པ, where the glossary note forbids the 'luật nghi' sense.
p0241, contrasted in the same sentence with འཇིག་རྟེན་ལས་འདས་པའི་སྤོང་ལམ. The pair should be fixed together.
p0241. སྤོང་ལམ = 'đoạn đạo' (斷道), the path that destroys the seed outright, as against the merely worldly ly tham that only weakens it.
p0240, in the *bản Thích* gloss on the Abhidharmasamuccaya's four cases.

p0241 l3, ལུས་དང་ལོངས་སྤྱོད་དང་སྲིད་པ་ལ་ལྟ་བ་ཤས་ཆེ་བའི་བསམ་པས. The existing ལྟ་བ entry (vi "kiến", status provisional, note "quan điểm where it is plainly non-technical") covers the noun dṛṣṭi = view and does not reach the verbal ལ་ལྟ་བ = looking toward / regarding. Text left unchanged and rendering carried consistently into c075 ("sự không đoái hoài" for མི་ལྟ་བ, p0242). A ruling is needed; if the ruling lands on a more neutral form (e.g. "sự nhìn về", "sự để tâm đến"), it must sweep c074 and c075 together.
No entry; consistent with earlier chunks.
No entry; matches c073 L103–112.
No entry; matches c073 L103–112.
No entry; p0241 l1, འཇིག་རྟེན་ལས་འདས་པའི་སྤོང་ལམ.
No entry; p0241 l1, འཇིག་རྟེན་པའི་ཆགས་བྲལ.
No entry; p0241 l1, in the མ་བྱིན་ལེན་ནས་…་བར list.
No entry; p0241 l1. Northern house style observed (sinh, not sanh).

p0192, the Vinayavibhaṅga story. སེར་སྐྱ is the Tibetan translation of Kapila; the Indian name is restored, following the project's practice with འཁོར་བ་འཇིག and ནོར་བཟང. ཤེད་བུ (māṇava, 'young man') is rendered only as 'người' — see flags.
p0192. སྟོན་པ follows the glossary's སྟོན་པ = đấng Đạo Sư.

p0192, epithet of Śākyamuni marking the end of the animal rebirth. Built on the pattern of the glossary's ཤཱཀྱའི་གཙོ་བོ = 'đấng Tối Thắng của dòng Thích-ca' so the two stay parallel but distinguishable.
p0192. Formed like the glossary's ལུང་གཞི = 'Luật Sự' (ལུང = Luật, ཕྲན་ཚེགས = 雜事 tạp sự).
p0192. 'Câu-lưu-tôn' already used in c065 for the same buddha, so this only registers the form with སྟོན་པ.

p0192, the king who had Krakucchanda's stūpa built. མཛེས་ལྡན is a Tibetan translation of an Indian name ('possessing beauty'); transcribed rather than back-formed, since the Sanskrit is not decisive. See flags.
p0192, the rebirth of the hired labourer. Same situation as མཛེས་ལྡན: a meaning-name ('possessing good renown/sound') transcribed rather than translated or back-formed. See flags.
p0192, the donor of the four zho of gold in the Naljorpa Chenpo / Jowo anecdote. Left in Tibetan transcription, as with Naktso, Drolungpa.
p0192, གསེར་ཞོ་བཞི = 'bốn zho vàng'. Tibetan weight measure; left untranslated rather than converted.
p0192. Established Sino-Vietnamese transliteration 摩竭 rather than a literal 'thủy quái'.

p0193. 'Chengawa' chosen over 'Chen-ngawa' because it is the majority corpus form (c019, c036) against c022's 'Chen-ngawa'; 'Geshe' without acute, following c022/c038 and the glossary's Geshe Dolpa. Both spellings are unregistered drift that predates this chunk.

p0193, ལྷ་བཟོ་ནི་འབྲིང in Jowo's reply — here the common noun 'image-maker', NOT the personal name. Deliberately distinct from the glossary's དགེ་བཤེས་ལྷ་བཟོ = 'Geshe Lhazo', where the same word is treated as a name.
p0193, the scribe in the Ngari anecdote.
p0193, in Sharawa's saying: disrespect for Dharma and its teachers is its cause.
p0193. Built on the glossary's དགེ་སྦྱོང = sa-môn; རྟགས rendered 'hình tướng' (the robes/marks), repeated as རྟགས་ཙམ = 'chút hình tướng'.
p0193 (and p0191, in c059). A place where one lies down when tired. Registered because c059 renders the same phrase 'chỗ thấp kém' — see flags.

p0193 l.3 `ཡིག་མཁན་ཞིག་སོ་དྲེག་གིས་ཆོས་ལ་བསྐུད་པ`. Here `ཆོས` denotes the physical book being copied, not the teaching. The fixed-set closes at pháp / Pháp / giáo pháp ("Nothing else"), so the text was brought back inside the set with the classifier bracketed as supplied. But the metonymy is genuinely in the Tibetan, and the same physical sense recurs wherever `ཆོས` stands beside `གླེགས་བམ`. A ruling is needed: either widen the set with an explicit metonymic form, or make the bracketed-classifier device the standing solution.

l.64, p0193 l.5 `དགེ་འདུན་དཀོན་མཆོག་ལྟར་གུས་པར་བྱེད་པ`. Same gap as `ཆོས་དཀོན་མཆོག`. Register the three members together (including `སངས་རྒྱས་དཀོན་མཆོག` = Phật Bảo) in one ruling so they cannot split later.
p0192. `རིགས` = 'class/kind' rendered "loài"; makara transcribed 摩竭 as "ma-kiệt". Unregistered; `ཆུ་སྲིན` alone will recur.

l.25 and l.29, p0192. Both are Tibetan *translations* of Indic names, transliterated here as if they were Tibetan personal names — while three lines later the chunk translates `འཇམ་དབྱངས` / `རྗེ་བཙུན་འཇམ་པའི་དབྱངས` as "Diệu Âm" / "đức Chí Tôn Diệu Âm" per the fixed entry. Inconsistent policy, and "Nyenpa Zangden" leaves `སྐད་སྙན་པ` ("giọng nói êm dịu") translated immediately beside the untranslated name it puns on, so the Vietnamese reader loses the point of the story. Wording kept pending a general ruling on translated-Indic names (translate the meaning, transliterate, or transliterate with a bracketed gloss at first occurrence).

p0253, cited as the authority that the third power destroys all previously accumulated obscurations. Established Sino-Vietnamese title (日藏經), following the precedent of སའི་སྙིང་པོའི་མདོ → Kinh Địa Tạng. Not verified against an existing Vietnamese edition.

p0253, source of the gloss 'ཕྱིན་ཆད་སྡོམ་མམ'. Built from the glossary's འདུལ་བ = Luật and the རྒྱ་ཆེར་འགྲེལ = Quảng Thích of ཤེས་རབ་སྒྲོན་མེའི་རྒྱ་ཆེར་འགྲེལ་པ. The underlying Indian work is NOT identified — see flags.

p0254, quoted at length on the exhaustion of obscurations by a powerful antidote. Built from the glossary's བརྒྱད་སྟོང་པ = Bát Thiên Tụng plus འགྲེལ་ཆེན = Đại Thích. Author not named in the source and not asserted here.
p0255, མཐོང་བའི་ཆོས་ལ་མྱོང་བར་འགྱུར inside the Tarkajvālā citation. Rendered by sense rather than as the technical 'hiện pháp', since the quotation must stay readable without a gloss.
p0254, inside the Bát Thiên Tụng Đại Thích citation (རློམ་སེམས་ཀྱི་ལྟུང་བའི་གནས). Rendering of the phrase as a whole is uncertain — see flags.

p0253, third member of the triad ལས་དང་ཉོན་མོངས་དང་ཆོས་ཀྱི་སྒྲིབ་པ. Rendered as an open triad ('các chướng ngại thuộc nghiệp, thuộc phiền não và thuộc pháp') rather than the fixed compounds nghiệp chướng / phiền não chướng / sở tri chướng, because the Tibetan writes སྒྲིབ་པ once over three qualifiers and does not say ཤེས་བྱའི་སྒྲིབ་པ. Kept distinct from the glossary's སྒྲིབ་པ = triền cái, which is the five-hindrances sense only.

terms.vi: cơn nhức đầu / cơn nóng đầu
terms.note: Two different Tibetan words for the same idea within three pages (ན་བ p0253, ཚ་བ p0255, the latter twice inside the Tarkajvālā citation). Kept distinct in Vietnamese rather than harmonised, since the second is inside a quotation.
p0254, the simile for what a strong antidote removes. གཡའ = tarnish/impurity on metal.

The registered ལྟུང་བ = 'đọa tội' is scoped by skt to āpatti (monastic offence). p0254 l.1 རློམ་སེམས་ཀྱི་ལྟུང་བའི་གནས, inside the Bát Thiên Tụng Đại Thích quotation, is the 'ground of downfall (of conceit)', not a monastic offence, so 'đọa tội' would misstate it. 'chỗ đọa lạc' kept; the entry needs a scope note splitting the two senses (also affects c067).

terms.vi: Tư duy riêng biệt về nghiệp quả
terms.note: Section heading 6.2.3.1.1.2.2.2, the sibling of ལས་འབྲས་སྤྱིར་བསམ་པ. བྱེ་བྲག་ཏུ = riêng biệt, kept distinct from c074's སོ་སོར་ཕྱེ་སྟེ་བསམ་པ.

terms.vi: công đức của dị thục / quả của dị thục / nhân của dị thục
terms.note: The three sub-headings of this section. ཡོན་ཏན = công đức and འབྲས་བུ = quả both follow existing fixed entries.
Used four times in the list of eight (ཚེ་ / ཁ་དོག་ / རིགས་ / དབང་ཕྱུག་ཕུན་སུམ་ཚོགས་པ). No glossary entry.
First of the eight công đức của dị thục, p0243.
Second of the eight. ཁ་དོག་ literally 'màu sắc/nước da'; rendered 'sắc tướng' because the gloss covers complexion, shape, faculties and proportion together. See flags.
Third of the eight. རིགས་ read as family/caste here (the gloss is རིགས་མཐོན་པོ་རྣམས་སུ་སྐྱེས་པ), i.e. the glossary's རིགས་སྐྱེས་པའི་མི = 'dòng dõi' sense, NOT 'chủng tánh'.
Fourth of the eight. Note the glossary's འཇིག་རྟེན་དབང་ཕྱུག = Thế Tự Tại is a proper name and unrelated.
Fifth of the eight. བཙུན་པ rendered 'được tôn trọng'; the gloss is that beings accept one's word (ཚིག་འཛིན་པར་འགྱུར་བ).

terms.vi: nổi tiếng có thế lực lớn
terms.note: Sixth of the eight.
Seventh of the eight; glossed ཕོའི་དབང་པོ་དང་ལྡན་པ = 'có nam căn'.
Eighth of the eight.
Second of the བསྡུ་བཞི, which glossary.json already registers collectively as 'bốn nhiếp pháp' without naming the members. p0244.
Third of the བསྡུ་བཞི. p0244.
Fourth of the བསྡུ་བཞི. p0244.

p0245. ཞིང kept as 'ruộng' following the glossary's བཀུར་བའི་ཞིང = 'ruộng tôn kính' and ཚོགས་གསོག་པའི་ཞིང = 'ruộng tích tập tư lương'; 'phước điền' deliberately avoided since the Tibetan has ཡོན་ཏན, not བསོད་ནམས.
p0245, the standard contraction of ཉན་ཐོས་རང་སངས་རྒྱས. Built from the glossary's ཉན་ཐོས = thanh văn and རང་སངས་རྒྱས = Độc Giác.
p0242, directed at Tam Bảo and thượng sư. Kept distinct from གནོད་སེམས = 'tâm làm hại', which occurs in the same sentence directed at chúng sinh.
p0244, twice (བསྒོ་བ་ལས་མི་འདའ་བ, བསྒོ་བ་ཉན་པ). Rendered non-technically rather than 'giáo lệnh'.

SCOPING REQUEST, not a fresh entry: the existing provisional entry gives འཁོར = 'hội chúng' (the audience being taught). At p0243 (འཁོར་ཕལ་ཆེ་བ, ལོངས་སྤྱོད་དང་འཁོར) it is a retinue/household, rendered 'quyến thuộc'; at p0244 (འཁོར་དུ་མི་འཇིགས་པ) it IS the assembly sense and is rendered 'hội chúng'. Both senses occur in this chunk.
p0245 verse, the fruit of non-jealousy. Rendered descriptively; see flags — this may be a term of art with a settled Vietnamese form.

New — raised by this repair. ཁ་དོག་ཕུན་སུམ་ཚོགས་པ (p0243) is now headed 'Màu da viên mãn' so the heading no longer absorbs དབྱིབས, which its own gloss (ཁ་དོག་དང་དབྱིབས་ལེགས་པས) keeps separate. 'màu da' matches how the gloss inside the same sentence already renders ཁ་དོག, but it is narrower than the word (colour, not specifically skin) and the item is conventionally 色具足. A ruling is needed on whether ཁ་དོག takes 'màu da', 'màu sắc', or 'sắc' — and it must not collapse onto གཟུགས, which the same sentence renders 'thân sắc'.
p0233, p0234. Rendered from the Tibetan components (རིན་པོ་ཆེ = bảo, ཕུང་པོ = uẩn/khối). Not verified against an existing Vietnamese edition.

terms.vi: Kinh Trừng Trị Kẻ Phá Giới
terms.note: p0233. Rendered literally from the components (ཚུལ་ཁྲིམས་འཆལ་བ = phá giới, ཚར་གཅོད་པ = trừng trị/chế phục). Sole occurrence in the corpus.
p0235 (×2). Established Sino-Vietnamese. Kept distinct from the glossary's ཆོས་བཅུ་པ = Kinh Thập Pháp.
p0235, sa-bcad heading. Established Sino-Vietnamese. Bare རྣམ་པར་སྨིན་པ rendered 'dị thục' in the p0232 body.
p0235, sa-bcad heading. Established Sino-Vietnamese.
p0235. Consistent with the glossary's དགེ་བཅུའི་ལས་ཀྱི་ལམ = 'mười thiện nghiệp đạo'; the bare form drops the virtue qualifier because the source does.

p0233, p0234. The third of the four 'doors of powerful karma' (ཞིང / རྟེན / དངོས་པོ / བསམ་པ) — the thing given or offered. Deliberately neutral so it stays distinct from ཟང་ཟིང = tài vật (glossary) and from རྫས.

p0234 (×2). Chosen so it stays separable from the four members of the reverence family already settled in decisions.md §5 (རིམ་གྲོ tôn kính / གུས་པ cung kính / བཀུར་སྟི, བཀུར་བ tôn trọng). This is a fifth term in that family and the decision should be folded into that entry.
p0233, in འཁོར་བསྒྱུར་གྱི་རྒྱལ་སྲིད = 'ngôi vua Chuyển Luân'. The variant འཁོར་སྒྱུར occurs at p0231 (chunk c071) and should take the same word.
p0234. Built on the glossary's ཐམས་ཅད་མཁྱེན་པ = Nhất Thiết Trí. In context it is bodhicitta, but the Tibetan does not write བྱང་ཆུབ་ཀྱི་སེམས here, so it was not substituted.

p0234, Bodhicaryāvatāra verse. The positive counterpart of the glossary's ཉེས་སྤྱོད = ác hạnh, kept as an exact mirror. Note that དགེ་བ is rendered 'việc thiện' throughout this chunk so the two do not collapse.
p0235 (×2). The niṣyanda result of lying. Read as passive ('being much slandered'); the Tibetan does not mark voice — see flags.

p0232. Sole occurrence in the corpus. Rendered by components (འགྱོད་པ = hối lỗi, ཚངས་པ = làm cho thanh tịnh), supported by the text's own gloss two sentences later (སྔ་མ་ལ་འགྱོད་པ་དང་...སྡིག་པ་མི་གསང་). 'sám hối' alone was avoided as too compact.

terms.vi: tràng phan của bậc Đại Tiên
terms.note: p0233. Built on the glossary's དྲང་སྲོང = đấng Đại Tiên. Rendered literally; the referent (the monastic robe) is not stated in the Vietnamese.
p0232; the same idiom recurs at p0665 (དུད་འགྲོ་ལ་ཟན་ཆངས་གཅིག་སྟེར་བ). A single unit of food given to an animal. 'vắt' supplies a shape the Tibetan does not specify — see flags.
p0232, sole occurrence. A Tibetan copper coin. Read from the debt frame (ཆགས་པ ... འཇལ་མི་ཕོད་པ) — see flags.

p0233 l.1, `ཁྱིམ་པ་ལྟ་བུས`. No entry exists; this is the only 'cư sĩ' in the whole corpus. Text KEPT. Collision to record in the ruling: glossary already has `དགེ་བསྙེན` (upāsaka) = 'cận sự nam' and `ཁྱིམ་བདག` (gṛhapati) = 'trưởng giả', and 'cư sĩ' is the conventional Vietnamese for upāsaka — so 'hàng cư sĩ' blurs a distinction the glossary draws. `ཁྱིམ་པ` here is simply the householder as opposed to the ordained (contrast `བྱང་སེམས་ཁྱིམ་ནས་བྱུང་བ` on the same page); 'hàng tại gia' would keep the three separable.

p0235 l.3, `སའི་དངོས་གཞིར་གསུངས`. Text KEPT. The short title `ས` for the Yogācārabhūmi plus its `དངོས་གཞི` division is unregistered; it recurs throughout the karma chapters, so it needs one fixed rendering.
The tenth non-virtue; both the long and contracted Tibetan forms rendered identically.
Matches c074.
Sino-Vietnamese, chosen to match c074's ཚིག་བཀྱལ = ỷ ngữ so the four speech non-virtues share one register.
p0225: the passage turns on ལས (nghiệp) vs ལས་ཀྱི་ལམ (nghiệp đạo), so the two must stay visibly distinct.
Denial/repudiation of cause, effect, function and existent things (p0224). 'phỉ báng nhân quả' is the established Vietnamese phrase for exactly this.
p0226, the pair. Note that ངོ་ཚ་མེད་པ in the five-mind lists (p0224, p0225) is rendered descriptively 'không biết hổ thẹn' because it is not there in the tàm/quý pair.
p0225 and p0226 (མཆོད་སྦྱིན་བྱེད་པ་དག = 'những kẻ hành tế tự', the brahmanical sacrificers whose view justifies killing).
p0225, listed beside bố thí and tế tự among what the wrong view denies.
p0226. Rendered by the Sino-Vietnamese 生主 rather than transliterated.
p0227. Consistent with the glossary's དགེ་སློང = tỳ-kheo.
p0227, twice, listed before A-la-hán and Độc Giác in both the killing and the stealing lists.
p0226, paired with འཇིག་རྟེན་པའི་ཆགས་བྲལ = 'sự ly tham thuộc thế gian' (wording taken from c074).
p0227. Rendered descriptively rather than 'già-lam' or 'tăng viên', since the Tibetan is the plain word for a pleasure-garden.
Fourth of the five minds completing hại tâm; the chunk opens on its tail. Must be kept distinct from འཁོན་དུ་འཛིན་པའི་སེམས (third of the five, on p0223 = c069). See flag.
Fifth of the five minds, recurring for both hại tâm (p0224) and tà kiến (p0225). The Tibetan names no agent for the overwhelming, and none is supplied.

terms.bo: གཞི (in the གཞི / བསམ་པ / སྦྱོར་བ / མཐར་ཐུག frame)
terms.note: The object-member of the four-part analysis of each karma-path, and the same word in གཞི་ལས་ལྕི་བ = 'nặng do cơ sở'. See flag: c067-c069 were not yet on disk, so this may need unifying with their choice.
p0225-p0226. Its members here: འདོད་ཆགས = tham ái (glossary), ཞེ་སྡང = sân, གཏི་མུག = si.
Unregistered. Ten non-virtues.
Unregistered; structural term for the whole chapter (`ལས་ལམ་བཅུ` = mười nghiệp đạo).
Unregistered; paired with `ཉེས་སྤྱད` = ác hạnh.
Unregistered; listed with `དགེ་སློང་མ` (tỳ-kheo-ni) in the tà dâm section.

p0202, source of the 'by day and by night' verse. A ཚོམས (varga) of the Udānavarga. Rendered from the Tibetan components (དྲན་པ = niệm, ཚོམས = phẩm). Related: c064 renders ཆེད་དུ་བརྗོད་པའི་ཚོམས as *Pháp Tập Yếu Tụng* — the two should be cross-linked once confirmed to be the same work. See flags.
p0205, source of the seven-line verse on the three positive individual precepts. Built from components (ཡན་ལག = chi, per glossary; དྲུག་པ = lục).

p0204. Follows the pattern already fixed for དཔུང་བཟང་གིས་ཞུས་པ = Kinh Diệu Tý Thỉnh Vấn and དྲག་ཤུལ་ཅན་གྱིས་ཞུས་པ = Kinh Ugra Thỉnh Vấn; སེང་གེ = Siṃha, translated (Sư Tử) rather than transliterated, as the Tibetan itself translates.
p0202, as a verbal act of the gods, not as the title ཆེད་དུ་བརྗོད་པའི་ཚོམས. See flags — the source doubles the word (ཆེད་དུ་བརྗོད་པས་ཆེད་དུ་བརྗོད་པའོ).
p0204 verse. Built on the glossary's འཕགས་པ = bậc thánh; 'tứ diệu đế' deliberately not used, since the Tibetan has no word for 'diệu'.
p0204 verse. Deliberately NOT 'bát chánh đạo': inside a quotation, 'chánh' would add a qualifier the Tibetan does not write. Uses the glossary's ཡན་ལག = chi so the eight stay countable.
p0204 verse, second of the four truths. Bare ཀུན་འབྱུང = 'sự tập khởi'; the compact 'tập đế' was not used because the verse does not say བདེན་པ on the individual members.
p0204, in the pair མི་དང་མི་མ་ཡིན.
p0204, མི་དང་མི་མ་ཡིན་གྱི་བར་གཅོད་ཀྱིས་མི་ཚུགས་པ. No glossary entry; kept distinct from the glossary's སྒྲིབ་པ = chướng/triền cái.
p0203, the devaputra about to be reborn as a pig.
p0203, in the Śaraṇagamanasaptati verse. Built on the glossary's སྡོམ་པ = luật nghi.
p0205, same saying. Transcription.
p0205, recipient of the lamrim transmission. Transcription.
p0204, མུ་སྟེགས་རླུང་ཞགས་གྲུབ་པ. Treated as a non-Buddhist personal name and left in transcription. See flags — the parse is not certain.

terms.bo: སྟོན་པ (sense 2: a teacher, not the Buddha)
terms.note: SCOPING gap surfaced by the fix above. The recorded སྟོན་པ = "đấng Đạo Sư" is scoped by its own note to the Buddha as Teacher. p0202 l.5 has སྟོན་པ་ངན་པ (in སྟོན་པ་དང་ཆོས་དང་གྲོགས་ངན་པ — a bad teacher, bad dharma, bad friend), where "đấng Đạo Sư xấu" would be incoherent. c063 keeps lowercase "bậc đạo sư xấu"; the entry needs to say the honorific form is reserved for the Buddha so Phase 5 does not report this line as drift.

p0236. Standard Sino-Vietnamese 等流果. Its two sub-forms in the same sentence: བྱེད་པ་རྒྱུ་མཐུན་གྱི་འབྲས་བུ = 'quả đẳng lưu tạo tác', མྱོང་བ་རྒྱུ་མཐུན་གྱི་འབྲས་བུ = 'quả đẳng lưu lãnh thọ'. Pairs with the corpus-established རྣམ་སྨིན་གྱི་འབྲས་བུ = 'quả dị thục'.

terms.vi: quả chủ tể / quả tăng thượng
terms.note: p0236, where the text gives both Tibetan names for the one result: 'བདག་པོའི་འབྲས་བུའམ་དབང་གི་འབྲས་བུ'. Rendered as two Vietnamese names so the doublet survives; 'quả chủ tể' (bdag po = chủ) is used again alone at p0238 where only བདག་པོའི་འབྲས་བུ appears. Collapsing both to the conventional 'quả tăng thượng' would erase the source's two words. See flag.
Cited at p0238 as ས་བཅུ་པ; also p0235-p0236 as ས་བཅུ་པའི་མདོ. No entry existed; glossary has only ཆོས་བཅུ་པ = Kinh Thập Pháp, a different work.
p0236 (ཕྱི་སྣོད་ཀྱི་འཇིག་རྟེན = 'khí thế gian bên ngoài') and p0237. Established Sino-Vietnamese 器世間. Kept apart from the glossary's སྣོད = 'bình chứa', which is the vessel simile.
Fourth member of the same four-part frame, p0238. Follows c069.
p0239, the འཕེན་རྫོགས་ཀྱི་དབྱེ་བ classification. 'mãn nghiệp' follows c074, which uses it for རྫོགས་བྱེད; 'dẫn nghiệp' is its counterpart. The verb འཕེན་པ is rendered 'dẫn phát', also following c074.
p0237, གནོད་སྦྱིན་གདུག་པ = 'dạ-xoa hung ác' in the adhipati result of malice.

p0237. Followed c069, which renders both ཚིག་བཀྱལ་པ (p0220) and ངག་བཀྱལ་པ (p0221-p0222) as 'lời tạp uế' throughout this same section. NOTE: c074 renders the identical term ཚིག་བཀྱལ as 'ỷ ngữ' — an existing drift that needs one ruling. See flag.
p0237 section heading དཀར་པོའི་ལས་འབྲས་བསམ་པ. Kept as the literal counterpart of ནག་པོའི་ལས so the black/white pair stays visible.
p0238, ཁམས་གོང་མ་གཉིས་ཀྱི་ལྷ. Rendered literally; the Tibetan does not name Sắc giới / Vô sắc giới here, so neither does the translation.

No entry exists. c072 renders it 'Kinh Thập Địa' twice on p0235; c073 had '*Thập Địa*' and is now aligned to the c072 form. decisions.md requires one fixed Vietnamese title per cited text. Two-chunk sweep (c072, c073) is already consistent once this is registered.

Kept as rendered — no ruling exists, and 'đại nguyện' is the established Vietnamese Buddhist form. But glossary.json registers the base word `སྨོན་ལམ` = 'phát nguyện' (provisional), and 'đại nguyện' shares no substring with it, so a Phase-5 sweep on སྨོན་ལམ will not see this compound. Register the compound explicitly, or overrule to 'đại phát nguyện' / 'phát nguyện lớn' and sweep. Occurs in the Daśabhūmika quotation, p0238 l.3.

Kept as rendered — no ruling exists. Word-order drift against c039 l.117, which has 'thiện xảo phương tiện' for the same term. Recurs throughout the book; needs one ruling plus a sweep over both forms.

Kept as rendered ('[quả] Độc Giác', p0238 l.3). glossary.json fixes the sibling `རང་སངས་རྒྱས` = 'Độc Giác' but has no entry for རང་རྒྱལ་བ. Register it cross-linked to རང་སངས་རྒྱས so the two Tibetan forms are recorded as sharing one Vietnamese rather than being silently collapsed.
p0236 l.3. No entry. Given in the source as the first of a pair of synonyms with དབང་གི་འབྲས་བུ ('བདག་པོའི་འབྲས་བུའམ་དབང་གི་འབྲས་བུ་ནི'), so both need registering together.
p0236 l.3. No entry. The alternative name the text offers for བདག་པོའི་འབྲས་བུ; register the two as a synonym pair so Phase 5 does not flag the differing Vietnamese as drift.
p0237. No entry; consistent with the corpus. Tenth of the ten non-virtuous paths. Keep distinct from ལྟ་བ་ངན (p0236 l.1, rendered 'ác kiến').

p0239 l.3. No entry. Half of the འཕེན་རྫོགས་ཀྱི་དབྱེ་བ pair that names this section; register with རྫོགས་བྱེད. The verbal forms འཕེན་པ / འཕངས་པ ('dẫn phát') and the Abhidharmasamuccaya gloss སྐྱེ་བ་འཕེན་པ ('dẫn phát sự thọ sinh') belong under the same entry.

p0212, cited for 'las rnams bskal pa brgyar yang ni...'. Distinct from ལུང་གཞི = *Luật Sự* (c051/c054/c065) and འདུལ་བའི་མདོ = *Luật Kinh* (c017/c024). Rendered from the components: ལུང = giáo điển (c065 already renders bare ལུང 'Giáo điển'), འདུལ་བ = Luật (glossary, bare, deliberately not 'Luật tạng').

terms.vi: mười nghiệp đạo đen / mười nghiệp đạo trắng
terms.note: p0213, p0215. Plain colour words kept plain, so the pair stays visibly contrastive. Note the tension with the glossary's དཀར་པོའི་ཆོས = 'bạch pháp': if Phase 5 prefers Sino-Vietnamese, these become 'hắc/bạch nghiệp đạo'. Related: ནག་པོའི་ལས་འབྲས / དཀར་པོའི་ལས་འབྲས → 'nghiệp quả đen / nghiệp quả trắng' (p0215 outline).

terms.vi: nghiệp đã làm chẳng mất hoại
terms.note: p0212, p0213. The fourth of the four general attributes of karma; c065 already fixed ལས་ངེས་པ = 'nghiệp là quyết định' and ལས་འཕེལ་ཆེ་བ = 'nghiệp tăng trưởng lớn'. The third, ལས་མ་བྱས་པ་དང་མི་ཕྲད་པ, is rendered 'việc chẳng gặp nghiệp chưa làm'. Chunk c066 (p0210-211), which introduces both, is not yet translated — it must follow these.

Sub-heading at p0213/p0215. 'xác định' rather than 'quyết trạch' so it does not collide with the title གཏན་ལ་དབབ་པ་བསྡུ་བ = *Nhiếp Quyết Trạch* (c074) or with the verb use of 'quyết trạch' in c015/c031/c032.

terms.vi: trình bày mười nghiệp đạo làm chính yếu
terms.note: The paired sub-heading at p0212-213.

terms.vi: suy xét theo lối phân chia riêng từng phần
terms.note: Section heading s084 (6.2.3.1.1.2.2.1.2). Wording taken verbatim from c065's forward reference to this section, so the two agree.

p0214 (Sāgara sūtra) and p0215 (Kṣitigarbha sūtra). Keeps བྱང་ཆུབ = bồ-đề (glossary, fixed) visible rather than absorbing it into the Chinese-derived 'chánh đẳng chánh giác'. Corpus has 'Chánh Đẳng Chánh Giác' only for ཡང་དག་པར་རྫོགས་པའི་སངས་རྒྱས (c007, c009), which is a different phrase.
p0214, Madhyamakāvatāra verse. Rendered literally rather than as 'thanh văn' (the glossary's ཉན་ཐོས), because the verse deliberately uses the descriptive epithet.

terms.vi: những vị tự mình quyết định nơi tự giác ngộ
terms.note: p0214, same verse. Kept descriptive rather than collapsed to 'Độc Giác' (glossary, fixed) for the same reason.

p0214, inside the Sāgara sūtra's list of things resting on the earth (villages, grasses, karmānta, seed-groups, crops). Sense here is 'occupations/works'. Rendered with the Sino-Vietnamese 業事 so it is not confused with ལས = nghiệp alone; c074's ལས་མཐའ་མ་ལོག་པ = 'nghiệp không điên đảo' is a different compound.

p0215. Follows c069, which already fixes the four-fold frame as cơ sở / ý lạc / gia hành / cứu cánh, with འདུ་ཤེས = tưởng, ཉོན་མོངས = phiền não, ཀུན་སློང = động cơ. Note: bare གཞི in the non-technical sense at p0213 (ཐེག་པ་གསུམ...འགྲུབ་པའི་གཞི) is rendered 'nền tảng' so the technical term stays traceable.

terms.bo: མཐའ (fifth member of the five-fold list) / མཐར་ཐུག
terms.note: p0215: the text gives a five-fold analysis (གཞི, འདུ་ཤེས, བསམ་པ, ཉོན་མོངས, མཐའ) and then a four-fold one ending in མཐར་ཐུག. Rendered with two different Vietnamese words so the two Tibetan words stay distinguishable; c069 uses 'cứu cánh' for མཐར་ཐུག, which is preserved.
p0215, Kṣitigarbha sūtra. Paired in the same sentence with བརྫུན་ཆེན་པོ་སྨྲ་བ = 'kẻ nói lời dối trá lớn' and ཆད་པར་སྨྲ་བ = 'kẻ chủ trương đoạn diệt'.
p0215. The text itself glosses it as a synonym of ངན་འགྲོ (ác thú, glossary), so it needs a fixed distinct rendering rather than being flattened into 'ác thú'.

NO RULING. houseStyle.register is "northern" but its rules list only sinh/sanh and phúc/phước; "chánh" vs "chính" is unruled, so the wording is KEPT. Corpus: "chánh đẳng" ×2 (both in c067, lines 92 and 123), "chính đẳng" ×0. Nothing else constrains it — decide once (northern register would imply "chính đẳng") and sweep.

NO RULING for the bare word. p0213 l5, སྐྱེས་བུའི་དོན་གཉིས = "hai mục đích của bậc trượng phu". 3× in corpus. The glossary registers only compounds (སྐྱེས་བུ་ཆུང་ངུ/འབྲིང/ཆེན་པོ = bậc hạ/trung/thượng, སྐྱེས་བུ་དམ་པ, སྐྱེས་བུ་ཐ་མ, སྐྱེས་བུ་མཆོག). Wording kept.
NO ENTRY. p0213 l3, in the pair ལེགས་སྤྱོད་ཉེས་སྤྱོད. Mirrors the registered ཉེས་སྤྱོད = ác hạnh; register as a pair so the two are never collapsed onto དགེ་བ/མི་དགེ་བ.
NO ENTRY. p0214, vocative addressing the Nāga king twice in the sūtra quotation. 2× in corpus. Note the registered ཀླུ་སྒྲུབ = Long Thọ is the only ཀླུ entry; bare ཀླུ is unruled.
